Position title: Director of Engineering

Location: Tucson, AZ.

Work Arrangement: Onsite; Full time

About Our Transition To Ondas Sentinel

World View was recently acquired by Ondas Inc. (NASDAQ: ONDS) and, together with DZYNE Technologies, has joined forces to create Ondas Sentinel. Ondas Sentinel is a next-generation U.S. defense platform integrating long-endurance ISR, autonomous systems, counter-UAS technologies, and mission intelligence.

While World View is now part of Ondas Sentinel, we are still legally operating as World View as we complete the formal integration of our systems and processes. As a result, you may see roles cross-posted across DZYNE and World View, during this transition. All positions represent opportunities within the same combined organization.

What does this mean for candidates?

You’re joining a team that is accelerating the future of autonomous defense
You’ll be part of a company backed by significant investment, strong growth, and mission-proven technology
You’ll work alongside world-class engineers and innovators who have already delivered thousands of operational flight hours, high-impact ISR capabilities, leading counter-UAS systems, and breakthrough autonomous effects
You’ll help shape a unified platform that enables operators to see more, decide faster, and act with confidence across the modern battlespace

Together, Ondas Sentinel is building something bigger than any one company, a scalable, integrated defense organization designed to meet emerging mission needs with speed, precision, and purpose.

If you’re energized by ambitious missions, rapid innovation, and a chance to help define the future of autonomous defense, we’d love to have you on the team.

Role Overview

The Director of Engineering is a senior technical and people leadership role responsible for leading the engineering organization while providing technical oversight across all Stratospheric ISR programs. This individual will establish engineering priorities, guide technical strategy, and lead multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete product development lifecycle—from concept development and system architecture through design, integration, verification, manufacturing, and operational deployment.

The ideal candidate combines deep systems engineering expertise with strong organizational leadership and a passion for developing high-performing teams. This role partners closely with Program Management, Operations, Manufacturing, Business Development, and executive leadership to deliver innovative, mission-critical aerospace systems.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering organization, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Establish engineering priorities and technical direction across multiple programs, ensuring alignment with company objectives and customer requirements
In partnership with the Chief Engineer, drive technology identification, assessment, application, and maturation roadmaps in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
Lead systems architecture, requirements development, and design activities for new platforms, payloads, software, ground systems, and supporting technologies
Provide technical oversight throughout the full system development lifecycle, including concept development, detailed design, integration, verification, validation, production, and sustainment
Oversee prototype development and rapid technology demonstrations to accelerate capability maturation and customer adoption
Define engineering execution plans, monitor technical performance, manage development costs, and ensure successful program execution
Implement project management processes and engineering metrics to monitor schedules, technical progress, risks, and resource utilization
Serve as the senior technical interface with customers, government stakeholders, strategic partners, and suppliers, providing technical leadership and innovative solutions
Lead the development and maintenance of system, subsystem, and component requirements while ensuring complete requirements traceability
Direct the creation and maintenance of technical documentation to support efficient program execution, configuration management, and compliance
Lead major technical reviews including System Requirements Reviews (SRR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Functional Configuration Audits (FCA), and other engineering milestone reviews
Coordinate system verification and validation activities to ensure products satisfy technical, operational, contractual, and regulatory requirements
Partner closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations, and Program Management to ensure successful transition from development into production and operational deployment
Promote engineering best practices, continuous process improvement, and disciplined systems engineering methodologies across the organization

Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree and preferred MS
15+ years of progressive engineering experience developing complex, integrated aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems
Minimum of 5 years of engineering management experience leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations
Demonstrated experience with systems engineering for complex platforms, including vehicles, payloads, command and control systems, ground systems, and supporting infrastructure
Experience leading products through the complete engineering lifecycle from concept through production and operational deployment
Strong understanding of systems architecture, requirements management, integration, verification, validation, and configuration management
Experience managing engineering budgets, schedules, technical risk, and resource planning
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and successfully deliver technically complex programs
Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence technical direction across multiple organizations
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance, if required

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering or related technical field
Experience with high-altitude platforms, aerospace vehicles, unmanned systems, ISR technologies, or defense systems
Experience with rapid prototyping and technology demonstrations
Familiarity with Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs), Manufacturing Readiness Levels (MRLs), and technology maturation processes
Experience supporting Department of Defense or government programs
Knowledge of aerospace quality systems, manufacturing development, and test engineering methodologies
Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing engineering organizations

What We Offer

You will work side by side with experts in emerging technology, gaining exposure to cutting edge ideas and projects that are shaping the future. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance because we believe in taking care of the you as a person, not just a team member.

Our Tucson workplace is designed to support collaboration, focus, and well-being, with an on-site environment that keeps supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, quality, and program teams closely connected to the mission.

We believe in creating a dynamic and inclusive workplace where creativity thrives, and every voice is heard. Our commitment to all team members is built upon five core cultural pillars: Engage, Lean In, Create, Care, and Own. Together, these pillars form the foundation of our employee experience while adhering to the highest standards of ethical and sustainable practices.

Some Final Notes

The description gives you a sense of what the position involves but is not an exhaustive list. We are a growing and evolving team, which means your responsibilities may shift or expand over time as new opportunities arise. Flexibility and curiosity are part of what makes our work exciting!

At Ondas Sentinel, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate belonging and diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from every background and life experience because we know our differences make us stronger.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering: Embedded Software
jobs.description:
Full Spectrum is an engineering services firm specializing in the design and development of innovative medical devices. We partner with leading companies in MedTech, from startups to Fortune 500 companies. With projects focused on embedded systems, mobile apps, and robotics, engineers at Full Spectrum love the challenge of working with clients on products that have a meaningful impact. Working across different client projects with a wide range of technologies, a career at Full Spectrum offers both technical and professional growth opportunities.

Director of Engineering, Embedded Software

The Director of Engineering, Embedded Software, will be a critical leader within our organization, responsible for the technical vision, strategic goals, and operational excellence of our embedded software development teams. This role requires a proven leader with deep expertise in embedded systems, a strong background in medical device development, and a comprehensive understanding of the regulatory landscape (e.g., IEC 62304). You will manage a team of talented embedded software engineers, oversee multiple client projects simultaneously, and serve as a key technical point of contact for our clients.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Demonstrated experience with hardware-software integration, including low-level driver development and debugging
Technical Leadership and Strategy:
· Collaborate directly with clients to define and execute the technical strategy for embedded software development projects, ensuring alignment with company goals and client needs.
· Provide hands-on technical guidance and architectural oversight for complex embedded software projects.
· Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in embedded systems, medical device development, and cybersecurity.
· Drive innovation and continuous improvement in our software development processes and toolchains.
· Project and Client Management
· Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle for multiple projects, from requirements definition through verification and validation.
· Collaborate with Technical Project Managers to ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
· Ensure all embedded software development activities comply with medical device regulations and standards (e.g., IEC 62304, ISO 13485), including software requirements specifications, software architecture and design documents, and risk management and cybersecurity plans and assessments (including FMEAs).
· Collaborate with Business Development staff to introduce prospective customers to the company’s capabilities and expertise and to develop technical proposals for new client work.
· Team and People Management:
· Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of embedded software engineers.
· Conduct performance reviews, provide career development opportunities, and foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and accountability.
· Recruit top talent and build a robust team to meet the demands of our growing business.

KEY SKILLS:

· 10+ years recent experience with modern embedded C++
· Experience developing medical devices or other safety critical systems
· Strong hands-on experience with embedded development on Linux, Windows, an RTOS, or bare metal
· Strong experience with modern SDLC processes (unit testing, static analysis, CI/CD)
· Strong familiarity with modern software development tools (Git, SVN, or other industry-standard source control) and SDLC processes
· Experience using Agile techniques, including task / issue management
· Demonstrated commitment to high quality
· Strong oral and written communication skills
· Highly motivated, self-disciplined, independent and results oriented
· Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics or related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience

DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering or related field
· 10+ years of experience in embedded software development, with at least 3 years in a leadership role
· Extensive experience with full product development lifecycle for medical devices, from concept to commercialization
· Proven expertise in C/C++ programming for embedded systems
· Deep understanding of real-time operating systems (RTOS) and embedded Linux
· Demonstrated experience with hardware-software integration, including low-level driver development and debugging
· In-depth knowledge of medical device regulations and standards, especially IEC 62304
· Experience with cybersecurity for embedded systems
· Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client-facing skills
· Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, services-based environment

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

· Experience with wireless communication protocols (e.g., Wi-Fi, BLE)
· Familiarity with other programming languages such as Python or C#
· Experience with micro-controllers from vendors like ARM, STM, or TI
· Experience with FPGA development

jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Design (PE) - 5K Power
jobs.description:
Director of Engineering & Design (PE)

Position Overview
5K Power is seeking an experienced Director of Engineering & Design (PE) to serve as the senior engineering authority leading the development of its temporary power, electrical distribution, power generation, and prefabricated electrical products.

Lifecycle Ownership: Responsible for guiding products from concept through engineering, design, fabrication, testing, field deployment, and continuous improvement
Ideal Background: A Professional Engineer (PE) with strong electrical engineering expertise and practical experience in electrical construction, manufacturing, prefabrication, power distribution, equipment integration, and relevant codes/standards
Hands-on Leadership: Collaborates across operations, manufacturing, estimating, procurement, sales, and executive teams to ensure products are engineered correctly, cost-effective, efficiently manufactured, and deployment-ready

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Professional Responsibility

Serve as the senior technical authority, establishing design standards, processes, and review procedures across all projects
Review, approve, and seal engineering designs, calculations, drawings, and technical documentation
Ensure strict compliance with NEC, NFPA, OSHA, UL, IEEE, local AHJ, and customer specifications
Provide primary technical support to manufacturing, operations, sales, and customers

Product Development & Electrical Engineering

Lead the engineering of temporary power skids, switchgear, transformer skids, spider boxes, mobile/EV charging, and data center solutions
Oversee full product lifecycles: Concept → Engineering → Design → Prototype → Testing → Manufacturing → Field Deployment → Standardization
Perform system designs and calculations, including load, short-circuit, voltage-drop, transformer sizing, and overcurrent protection coordination
Develop one-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, panel schedules, and equipment specifications

Manufacturing Integration & Standardization

Design for manufacturability (DFM) to optimize production, reduce labor and material waste, and speed up fabrication
Develop repeatable fabrication methods, standardized components, assembly documentation, and BOMs
Create and maintain the 5K Power Engineering Standards Manual to build a repeatable product platform rather than engineering every project from scratch

VDC / BIM Technology Integration

Lead coordination with VDC/BIM teams to convert engineering designs into accurate fabrication models and shop drawings
Establish modeling standards and develop a standardized digital product library to improve constructability and field installation

Quality, Reliability & Cost Optimization

Establish QC procedures, participate in product testing/commissioning, and conduct root-cause analysis on field failures
Support commercial efforts by identifying cost reductions, evaluating alternate components, and assisting with custom-product feasibility and pricing

Team Leadership

Hire, mentor, and develop engineering staff
Establish design schedules, team KPIs, scalable processes, and career development paths

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Engineering schedule performance, design accuracy, and cycle times
Engineering-related rework, warranty issues, and field failure rates
Manufacturing efficiency, labor hours, and material cost reductions
Product quality, standardization, and successful product launches
Regulatory compliance and customer satisfaction

Qualifications

Required:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline
Licensure: Active Professional Engineer (PE) license
Experience: 10+ years of engineering experience with a focus on electrical power distribution
Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of the NEC, low-to-medium voltage systems, transformers, switchgear, and engineering documentation
Leadership: Proven ability to lead engineering teams and collaborate cross-functionally

Preferred:

Experience with temporary power systems, electrical prefabrication, data center infrastructure, and UL-listed equipment/NRTL certification
Proficiency in BIM/VDC, AutoCAD, Revit, or Navisworks
Background in Lean Manufacturing or Design for Manufacturing (DFM)

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on builder, designer, and technical leader who understands the complete product journey from design and procurement through fabrication, testing, and field energization. Comfortable engaging directly with shop fabricators to refine designs and continuously improve products.

Why 5K Power

5K Power is building a new generation of engineered power solutions focused on speed, reliability, standardization, and innovation.

The Director of Engineering & Design will have a significant opportunity to build the engineering infrastructure behind the company and help transform innovative concepts into repeatable, commercially viable products deployed across the electrical construction and power infrastructure markets.

This position will have a direct impact on the development of the 5K Power product platform, engineering standards, manufacturing capabilities, and future product roadmap.

jobs.title: Director, Development
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The New York Stock Exchange, a subsidiary of Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE), presents a unique opportunity for a full-time hands-on Director of Engineering to lead and drive the strategic technical vision for trading systems development in a high throughput, low latency trading environment. This senior leadership role carries end-to-end ownership of the architecture, design, and delivery of core systems powering NYSE Equity and Options markets on the cutting-edge Pillar platform. The Director of Engineering will lead multiple engineering teams, set the long-term technical direction, and serve as the key decision-maker on platform architecture — ensuring world-class reliability, performance, and innovation across the trading technology portfolio.

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design Ownership
Own and drive the end-to-end system architecture and technical roadmap for NYSE's high performance, high availability, high throughput trading platform.
Serve as the final technical authority on architectural and design decisions, ensuring alignment with long-term business strategy and scalability goals.
Define and enforce engineering standards, design patterns, and best practices across all teams and system components.
Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies and approaches to maintain a competitive, next-generation platform.

Engineering Leadership & Team Development
Lead, mentor, and grow multiple engineering teams, including Principal Engineers, Senior Engineers, and individual contributors, fostering a culture of technical excellence and accountability.
Recruit, retain, and develop top-tier engineering talent; drive career development, succession planning, and performance management across the organization.
Champion a collaborative and innovative engineering culture that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Strategic Planning & Execution
Partner with senior business, product, and operations leadership to translate business objectives into technical strategy and execution plans.
Own program-level planning, prioritization, and delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives with organization-wide impact.
Establish and track key engineering metrics (system performance, reliability, delivery velocity) and drive continuous improvement against those benchmarks.
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, and resource allocation decisions.

Operational Excellence
Ensure the highest levels of system reliability, availability, and regulatory compliance for mission-critical trading infrastructure.
Drive incident management, root-cause analysis, and systemic improvements to reduce operational risk.
Effectively represent engineering in cross-organizational forums, regulatory reviews, and executive-level discussions.

Knowledge And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related degree.
15+ years of progressive hands-on software engineering experience, including significant depth in C/C++ development on Linux.
5+ years in a senior engineering leadership role with demonstrated experience managing and scaling multiple teams.
Proven track record of owning and driving large-scale system architecture and design for high performance, low latency, mission-critical platforms.
Deep expertise in data structures, algorithmic complexity, systems programming, and performance-oriented software design.
Strong hands-on background with TCP/IP, Multicast network protocols, multithreading, and real-time systems.
Experience with scripting languages and automation in complex engineering environments.
Experience with AI assisted coding tools and agents for automating development workflows

Leadership And Strategic Skills

Demonstrated ability to set technical vision, influence across organizational boundaries, and drive alignment between engineering, business, and operations leadership.
Experience managing engineering budgets, roadmaps, and cross-functional programs at scale.
Strong executive communication skills — ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and represent engineering at the executive level.
Track record of building, mentoring, and retaining high-performing engineering organizations.
Experience operating within regulated financial services or exchange environments is strongly preferred.

New York Base Salary Range

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $215,000 - 285,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 33 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.35 bn.in 2023. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

Job Summary

We're seeking a Director of Facilities Engineering & Operations
to lead facilities, maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, and capital projects at our aerospace manufacturing site in Garden Grove. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of the systems that support production, including cleanrooms, HVAC, electrical distribution, compressed air, chilled water, and other critical utilities. Our operations rely on highly reliable facilities and controlled environments to manufacture mission-critical aerospace components. Your leadership will help ensure business continuity, support customer delivery commitments, strengthen regulatory compliance, and position the site for future growth.

Job Responsibilities

Lead Facilities & Maintenance Operations

Provide strategic leadership for facilities engineering, maintenance, utilities, and infrastructure.
Develop operating plans, budgets, staffing strategies, and reliability initiatives.
Partner with Operations, Quality, EH&S, Supply Chain, Finance, and HR to support site objectives.

Drive Reliability & Business Continuity

Ensure uptime and performance of critical building systems and manufacturing utilities.
Lead recovery efforts during major equipment, utility, or infrastructure disruptions.
Drive preventive and predictive maintenance programs, asset management, and root cause problem solving.

Lead Capital & Infrastructure Projects

Develop and execute a multi-year capital roadmap.
Oversee facility upgrades, infrastructure improvements, and equipment replacement projects.
Manage contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project teams to deliver projects safely, on time, and within budget.

Ensure Compliance & Safety

Support compliance with AS9100, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, Cal/OSHA, and customer requirements.
Partner with EH&S to maintain environmental, health, and safety standards.
Ensure facilities remain audit-ready and support regulatory compliance.

Build High-Performing Teams

Lead and develop facilities, maintenance, and technical teams.
Establish clear performance expectations, accountability, and continuous improvement practices.
Create a culture centered on safety, reliability, and operational excellence.

Job Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, chemical, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
10+ years of leadership experience managing engineering, maintenance, facilities, or technical teams.
Experience supporting critical utilities and infrastructure, including HVAC, cleanrooms, compressed air, chilled water, steam, and plant electrical systems.
Capital project leadership experience from planning through commissioning.
Knowledge of AS9100, ISO standards, regulatory compliance, and customer audits.
Strong leadership, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Must qualify as a U.S. Person under ITAR regulations.

Preferred

CMRP, PMP, PE, or similar professional certification.
Aerospace manufacturing experience supporting major OEM or defense customers.
Experience with cleanrooms, CNC operations, chemical processing, coatings, autoclaves, glass, or acrylic manufacturing.
Experience implementing reliability programs, FMEA, CMMS systems, and predictive maintenance strategies.
Experience leading both union and non-union teams.

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?

A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working

Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineering Director
jobs.description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

As the Infrastructure Engineering Director, you'll own FanDuel's foundational cloud and outpost-based infrastructure layer. You'll establish operational excellence, standardization, and reliability across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and cloud provisioning that everything else runs on. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you set the standard for how infrastructure operates, not just keeping systems running but making them run predictably, with clear processes, documented procedures, and a culture that values doing things right.

This role lands at a critical juncture. FanDuel is scaling rapidly across new markets and cloud footprints. Your infrastructure foundation must handle that growth without creating operational chaos or cost surprises. You'll drive standardization (provisioning, observability, disaster recovery, cost attribution), establish discipline (operational runbooks, change management, incident response), and build an infrastructure team that operates with rigor and purpose. You'll manage vendor relationships, own cloud spend and capacity planning, and balance cost optimization with reliability and resilience.

By connecting infrastructure behavior to real business impact, you'll drive improvements in reliability, performance, cost, and operational maturity. You'll partner closely with Platform Engineering leadership and product teams to ensure our foundation actually supports what they need to build.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

Establishing infrastructure strategy and standards across cloud provisioning, observability, disaster recovery, and cost governance. Standardization removes ambiguity and makes operations safer and faster.
Building and scaling the infrastructure engineering team with operational rigor and discipline. Hiring for people who care about documentation, reliability, and unglamorous work. Creating career paths and developing infrastructure engineers into senior and leadership roles.
Owning disaster recovery strategy, RTO/RPO definitions, testing, and organizational readiness. If DR hasn't been tested, it doesn't exist.
Establishing SLOs/SLIs for foundational infrastructure services. Making clear tradeoffs between cost optimization and reliability; these aren't opposing goals but they require transparency.
Designing and evolving cloud infrastructure for resilience, cost, and operational clarity. Managing AWS, outposts, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, mesh, and compute provisioning.
Setting standards for operational discipline: change management, incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement. Protecting infrastructure engineers from burnout while celebrating unglamorous work.
Managing vendor relationships, cloud costs, and capacity planning. Owning the business relationship with infrastructure: negotiating contracts, optimizing spend, planning cloud adoption roadmap.
Leading complex production incident response across infrastructure domains: Kubernetes, networking, DNS, load balancing, service mesh, cloud services.
Stewarding infrastructure platforms operating under strict regulatory and compliance requirements. Ensuring secure operation, auditability, and disciplined change management.
Partnering with engineering and product leadership to influence platform direction, roadmap priorities, and long-term infrastructure strategy.
Evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and vendor capabilities against infrastructure requirements and operational sustainability goals.
Mentoring engineers and raising infrastructure, platform networking, and operational maturity across the organization.

A Sneak Peek Into Our Tech Stack

AWS (including Outposts), Kubernetes (EKS, 100+ clusters) , Kong Gateway & Kong Mesh, Terraform, Helm and Datadog

THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

Significant experience leading platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure organizations.
Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, operations, and scaling. Working knowledge of container orchestration, cluster design, workload isolation, and multi-cluster management.
Strong hands-on understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure: VPCs, networking, IAM, EC2, EKS, cost management, and operating hybrid AWS environments including Outposts.
Experience defining and driving platform, reliability, or infrastructure strategy across teams, with the ability to influence technical direction and set standards.
Proven ability to establish operational discipline: documented runbooks, change management processes, incident response frameworks, and blameless post-mortem culture.
Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery, RTO/RPO definitions, failover testing, and resilience improvements across production systems.
Experience defining and implementing SLOs, SLIs, and alerting strategies for infrastructure services using user-centric and business-aligned metrics.
Strong software engineering fundamentals with proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Ability to build scalable tooling and automation.
Track record of driving large-scale operational improvements through automation, reducing organizational toil, and preventing recurring classes of issues.
Understanding of cloud cost drivers and the ability to optimize spend without sacrificing reliability, resilience, or team velocity.
Strong analytical and communication skills. Ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. Can translate infrastructure constraints into business and customer impact.
A mindset of ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term platform sustainability. You know when standards are working and when they need to change.

Bonus

Experience with service mesh platforms (Kong Mesh, Istio, Linkerd, or Envoy-based systems).
Hands-on experience managing AWS Outposts or hybrid cloud infrastructure.
Experience operating infrastructure in regulated industries where network segmentation, auditability, security controls and uptime are critical.
CNCF Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKS, CKAD).
Familiarity with observability platforms like Datadog, Prometheus, and tracing systems.

Don’t check all the boxes? That’s okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position.

About Fanduel

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

Title: Director of Broadcast Engineering

Requisition ID#: 4801

Location:

Louisville, KY, US, 40208

Property: Churchill Downs Racetrack

Pay Range

Churchill Downs Racetrack (“CDRT”), the world’s most legendary racetrack, has been the home of The Kentucky Derby, the longest continually held annual sporting event in the United States, since 1875. Located in Louisville, CDRT features a series of themed race days during Derby Week, including the Kentucky Oaks, and conducts Thoroughbred horse racing during three race meets in the Spring, September and Fall. CDRT is located on 175 acres and has a one-mile dirt track, a 7/8-mile turf track, a stabling area, and provides seating for approximately 60,000 guests. The stable area has barns sufficient to accommodate 1,400 horses and a 114-room dormitory for backstretch personnel. CDRT also has a year-round simulcast wagering facility . www.ChurchillDowns.com.

Job Summary

The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading all broadcast engineering operations supporting Churchill Downs Racetrack's live racing, television productions, simulcast operations, and special events. This hands-on leadership role oversees the installation, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of broadcast, audio, video, and broadcast IT systems that ensure reliable, high-quality production and venue operations.

Working closely with the Senior Director/Executive Producer, production leadership, operations, and broadcast partners, this position provides technical leadership for live broadcasts, engineering projects, infrastructure upgrades, and day-to-day operations while leading an engineering team in a fast-paced, high-pressure live production environment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Broadcast Engineering & Technical Operations

Install, configure, maintain, and support broadcast equipment, videoboard operations, venue audio systems, and broadcast IT infrastructure.
Configure and support Evertz routers, RTS intercom systems, KVM systems, QSC audio systems, Dante audio networks, QAM headend systems, and fiber optic infrastructure.
Support day-to-day broadcast operations, live events, and television productions while ensuring operational readiness and system reliability.
Coordinate frequency management and signal distribution for major live events.

Engineering Leadership & Project Management

Lead and manage the broadcast engineering team while overseeing multiple technical projects and live event operations.
Participate in venue construction and infrastructure projects related to broadcast systems.
Provide overall design feedback for construction and infrastructure projects at appropriate times to ensure alignment with the multi-year lifecycle.
Provide technical leadership and make real-time operational decisions in a high-pressure live production environment.

Governance, Security & Lifecycle Management

Partner closely with Corporate IT, Information Security, and other technology teams to ensure broadcast networks, systems, software, and connected devices meet company security and technology standards.
Maintain accurate system and asset documentation, support security assessments and remediation activities, and actively participate in cross-functional troubleshooting through resolution.
Develop and maintain a multi-year lifecycle and technology roadmap for broadcast, audio, video, network, and supporting software infrastructure.
Proactively identify aging, unsupported, or end-of-life technologies and devices and participate in annual capital planning and budgeting to ensure critical systems are refreshed, upgraded, or replaced before they create operational, security, or reliability risks.

Broadcast Partner Support

Serve as the primary engineering liaison with broadcast partners regarding technical setup and venue requirements.
Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to support successful broadcast operations and live event execution.
Perform other duties as assigned.

REGULATORY

Ability to obtain and maintain a Kentucky racing license and successfully complete all applicable background check requirements.

Required Skills And Abilities

Advanced knowledge of broadcast engineering systems and live production operations.
Strong leadership, project management, process, and engineering team development skills.
Expertise supporting broadcast control room operations and production workflows.
Proficiency with QSC audio systems, Dante audio networking, Evertz routing systems, RTS intercom systems, and KVM infrastructure.
Strong understanding of broadcast IT networks, signal distribution, fiber optic systems, and RF frequency coordination.
Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across Broadcast Engineering, Information Technology, Information Security, Operations, and external partners, including shared ownership of troubleshooting and issue resolution.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and standard engineering documentation software.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree required; 12+ years of relevant broadcast engineering experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
10+ years of engineering management experience supporting broadcast or live production environments.
Demonstrated experience supporting live television broadcasts, studio productions, and major live events.
Experience in a sports venue required; horse racing experience preferred.
Experience with QSC audio systems, Dante networking, broadcast IT systems, fiber optic infrastructure, and venue broadcast operations.
QSC, Dante, Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE), and Fiber Optic certifications preferred.
Experience with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu preferred.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

Ability to lift, move, and install broadcast equipment weighing up to 70 pounds.
Ability to work on ladders, rooftops, elevated platforms, and in confined spaces.
Regular standing, walking, climbing, bending, kneeling, and moving throughout the facility to support engineering operations.
Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, rotating schedules, and extended hours as required to support racing events and live broadcasts.
Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure live production environment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

We’re always learning, evolving and growing. We innovate through mutual respect of ideas and collaboration. About Veeco

You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers.

Overview

Veeco is scaling the ion beam deposition platform to meet rapidly growing demand from manufacturers building the optical infrastructure that powers next-generation artificial intelligence data centers. As Senior Director, Engineering - Advanced Deposition Systems, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for translating customer demand, product strategy, and manufacturing requirements into reliable, production-ready semiconductor equipment. Your decisions directly influence engineering capacity, product quality, customer satisfaction, and the speed at which Veeco can deliver critical systems to the market. You will unify Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, and Software Engineering teams around a common execution model while driving multiple product development, customer customization, qualification, and production initiatives simultaneously. This is an opportunity to shape both the future of the platform and the engineering organization required to scale it successfully.

Responsibilities

Lead Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, and Software Engineering organizations through requirements, architecture, design, validation, production release, and field support.
Deliver multiple concurrent development and customer programs that meet schedule, quality, cost, reliability, and customer performance commitments.
Establish engineering operating mechanisms, metrics, and governance processes that improve predictability, accountability, and execution speed.
Drive system-level decisions that balance technical performance, manufacturability, serviceability, cost, and long-term product reliability.
Partner with Operations, Product Management, Technology, Supply Chain, and Customer Support to ensure seamless transition from concept through production and field deployment.
Build and develop engineering leadership talent capable of sustaining long-term product growth and organizational scale.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline and 15+ years of engineering experience developing complex capital equipment, semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, photonics equipment, or other highly engineered products is required. 7+ years of leadership experience managing engineering managers or multi-disciplinary engineering organizations is a must.

Deep system-level understanding of complex electro-mechanical products and the interfaces between hardware, controls, software, and process performance.
Skilled at converting customer and market requirements into executable engineering plans with clear milestones, risks, and resource requirements.
Experience with semiconductor processing equipment, vacuum systems, thin-film deposition technologies, ion beam technologies, photonics manufacturing equipment, or optical coating systems.

jobs.description:
About Us

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description

As Vice President of Software Engineering for our Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) portfolio, you will lead a global organization of engineers across multiple product lines that finance teams rely on to plan, close, consolidate and report. You will own how that portfolio is built, shipped and run.

2027 is a transformation year. We are modernizing established applications, building new SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities, moving to an agentic software development lifecycle, and putting AI directly into the hands of our customers. We need a leader who can deliver all four at once without compromising the quality and reliability our customers depend on for their most critical financial processes, and who measures success with the same discipline our customers apply to their numbers.

We enjoy our work as much as we enjoy working together, and we want leaders who get things done while having a positive influence on our workplace environment.

What You Will Deliver In 2027

Modernize legacy applications
Define and execute a modernization strategy for the EPM portfolio, choosing deliberately between re-platform, re-architect, strangler-pattern migration, and retirement for each product and component
Sequence modernization to deliver customer value incrementally, avoiding big-bang rewrites and protecting customers already in production
Reduce technical debt measurably, with a visible debt register, investment targets and progress reported to executive leadership
Plan and execute customer migrations from on-premise and single-tenant deployments with clear data-integrity, cutover and rollback plans
Build SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities
Lead the design and delivery of cloud-native, multi-tenant services, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, configuration and extensibility models
Build the shared platform capabilities that product teams rely on: identity, observability, metering, tenant provisioning, and self-service environments
Own SaaS operational excellence: SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident management, capacity planning, cost efficiency, and disaster recovery
Embed security, privacy and compliance (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) into architecture and delivery pipelines rather than treating them as downstream gates
Deliver with an agentic SDLC
Lead the shift from AI-assisted coding to an agentic software development lifecycle, where AI agents participate in planning, coding, testing, code review, documentation and operations
Establish the guardrails that make this safe: human review policy, test and evaluation gates, provenance and traceability of AI-generated changes, and secure handling of code and data
Redesign team workflows, roles and skills for agentic delivery, and coach engineering managers and engineers through the change
Measure the impact rigorously, proving gains in flow, quality and reliability rather than tracking adoption alone
Build customer-facing AI features
Partner with Product to deliver AI capabilities that finance users trust, such as natural-language analysis, forecasting assistance, anomaly detection and agentic workflows across planning, close and reporting
Build the engineering foundations for production AI: model and prompt management, retrieval over governed financial data, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring for accuracy, drift and cost
Apply responsible-AI practices appropriate to financial data, including explainability, auditability, tenant data isolation, and clear human-in-the-loop controls
Ship AI features on the same delivery standards as the rest of the portfolio: tested, observable, reversible and measured against defined quality bars
Raise the bar on quality and DORA outcomes
Own engineering outcomes against the DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, failed deployment recovery time, and rework rate), with transparent baselines and quarterly improvement targets for every product line
Build quality in: test automation across the pyramid, continuous integration on every change, trunk-based development, feature flags, and progressive delivery
Make reliability a product feature through service-level objectives, error budgets that inform prioritization, and blameless post-incident reviews that lead to lasting fixes
Shift security left with automated scanning, dependency and vulnerability management, and secure-by-default pipelines
Report development status, quality, operations and system performance to executive management using a consistent engineering scorecard, and act quickly and decisively to resolve customer-impacting issues

Leadership Responsibilities

Lead multiple software development teams and product lines, including staffing, mentoring, and building high-performing teams across multiple disciplines and geographies
Collaborate with architects, product managers, software development managers and developers to arrive at the best technical design and approach, delivering value quickly without sacrificing quality
Drive engineering roadmaps, operational plans and delivery commitments within an Agile/Lean environment, balancing modernization, new capability and operational health
Manage departmental budget and resources, including the mix of full-time employees, contractors and suppliers, and negotiate contracts and SOWs with vendors
Build an engineering culture of ownership, psychological safety, continuous improvement and customer focus, where teams own what they build in production
Evolve the software development practice across the organization, including practices, tooling, reporting and methodology

Competencies

Proven delivery leader – Brings deep software development and operational management experience and shows what good looks like in practice
Transformation leadership – Leads large-scale technical and organizational change while keeping the business running
Quality and reliability mindset – Treats quality, security and reliability as non-negotiable outcomes, and knows how to engineer them into the system
Data-driven decision making – Uses metrics to understand flow and outcomes, and to guide investment, not to police teams
Leadership and vision – Inspires people at all levels to follow a clear technical and operational vision
Planning and management – Highly effective planning, organizational and operational skills
Discipline and perseverance – Commitment to solving complex issues through to completion
Adaptability – Operates in a fast-paced, iterative environment; learns and adapts to new business demands and fast-changing AI technologies
Problem solving – Strong critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities
Effective communicator – Excellent written, presentation and oral communication at both executive and team level
Prioritization – Uses a sense of urgency to prioritize effectively and manage time well

Required

Qualifications and experience

BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline
Prior experience serving as a Vice President of Engineering, with 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience
10+ years of software development experience, with at least five years building and running cloud products using Java, C#, and JavaScript/TypeScript
7+ years leading multiple Agile teams and programs, with expert understanding of Agile and Lean principles
5+ years driving full DevOps and continuous delivery practices, with a demonstrated track record of improving DORA metrics and software quality at scale
3+ years managing global engineering teams and suppliers across multiple products, including teams built from a combination of FTE and contractor resourcing
Proven experience leading the modernization of legacy or on-premise enterprise applications to cloud-native SaaS, including customer migrations
Hands-on leadership experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture and operational production responsibility, including SLOs, incident management and on-call
Demonstrated experience using AI and agentic tooling to measurably improve the productivity and quality of engineering teams across a product portfolio
Proven ability to manage multiple product lines and meet release commitments
Experience negotiating contracts and SOWs with vendors

Preferred

Master's degree in a technical or business discipline
Experience shipping customer-facing AI or machine learning features to production, including LLM-based capabilities, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation frameworks
Experience with EPM, FP&A, financial close or other finance applications where accuracy and auditability are critical
Experience operating under enterprise security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR
Familiarity with platform engineering and internal developer platforms
Broad experience across application platforms, middleware, frameworks, cloud providers (AWS, Azure) and programming languages

About Tri Imaging Solutions

Tri Imaging Solutions has merged with DirectMed Imaging, uniting two trusted names in the medical imaging industry under one organization. Tri Imaging Solutions is our go-forward brand, so the Tri Imaging Solutions name and logo now represent our combined company. You may have found this opening on DirectMed Imaging's careers page or LinkedIn - it is the same team, and your application goes to the same place.

Founded in 2013 and headquartered just north of Nashville in Madison, TN, Tri Imaging Solutions helps healthcare providers keep their diagnostic imaging systems running - supplying quality-tested replacement parts, equipment, and nationwide service across CT, MRI, mammography, X-ray, and more. jobs.title: Director, Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Lumotive is pioneering the era of programmable optics—where light is controlled as intelligently and flexibly as software.

At the heart of this transformation is a once-in-a-generation innovation: a flat CMOS-based “general purpose optic.” Lumotive’s Light Control Metasurface (LCM™) beam forming chips can be programmed to function as a beam steering mirror, a lens, mirror, a beam splitter—or any optical function—replacing bulky and mechanical optical components with a fully digital, reconfigurable semiconductor . This breakthrough lays the foundation for a massive shift in multiple technologies—from 3D sensing and imaging to optical networking, free space optical communication, and beyond. Like the shift from analog to digital in electronics, programmable optics will reshape industries from robotics, self-driving cars, AI, defense, and healthcare.

Lumotive’s first commercial application is in LiDAR, where its software-defined beam steering chips are already enabling compact, high-performance, solid-state sensors. These sensors are being deployed today in smart infrastructure, robotics, and mobility systems through leading module makers and solution integrators.

With more than 200 patents and growing commercial traction, Lumotive is delivering the world’s first digital platform for light—and redefining what’s possible in the optical age.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Director of Reliability Engineering to own reliability end to end — from the physics of how an LCM degrades to the qualification data package delivered for customer sign-off.

The LCM is a new class of semiconductor device: a CMOS backplane, novel thin-film material stacks, and liquid crystal. It ships into products whose mission profiles range from climate-controlled indoor robotics to outdoor infrastructure and automotive-grade exposure. The standard qualification playbooks were not written for this device, and the acceleration models often have to be built from data we generate ourselves.

You will set the reliability and qualification strategy for the LCM and the reference designs in which they are deployed, collect customer mission profiles and translate them into stress conditions and lifetime requirements, run the studies that determine whether we meet them, and drive the findings back into process, materials, design, and system architecture. You will also present our reliability data directly to customers and their quality teams.

We want someone who runs qualification surgically: studies that are carefully designed, well controlled, and executed as planned, so the result holds up when a customer challenges it. Someone with the depth to work unfamiliar failure modes from first principles, the judgment to know which risks matter at the system level, and the instinct to hunt for the failure modes we have not characterized yet — before a customer finds them.

Responsibilities:

Own the reliability pipeline end to end — from fundamental LCM failure-mechanism studies through component, module, and system qualification, to the data package delivered for customer sign-off. You are accountable for our lifetime claims and the evidence behind them
Own customer mission profiles. Work with sales, applications, and systems engineering to collect use conditions across a widening set of products — thermal and humidity profiles, duty cycles, optical exposure, power cycling, lifetime expectations — and convert them into qualification plans
Run qualification surgically. Design each study to isolate the mechanism in question — controls, sample structure, stress levels, readpoints — and hold execution to that plan
Unearth the failure modes we have not seen yet. Maintain a living map of known, suspected, and unexamined mechanisms across chip, package, and module, and design the experiments that close the gaps before a customer finds them
Build lifetime models — time-to-failure distributions, acceleration factors, activation energies, sample size and confidence bounds — and defend the assumptions under customer scrutiny
Close the loop into design and process. Drive Design for Reliability and Design for Test reviews so our products are stress-able and testable, and correlate reliability outcomes to fab process splits, materials, and assembly variables through split-lot DOEs with process and packaging partners
Define screening strategy — pass/fail criteria, burn-in, production screens, and ongoing reliability monitoring — to keep early failures out of customer deliveries
Represent reliability to customers. Present data, negotiate qualification scope, and answer customer quality teams directly
Work across teams. Reliability touches LCM process and device, ASIC, hardware, systems, manufacturing, and program management; make sure a finding in one team turns into a decision in the others
Build and lead the reliability team. Hire, mentor, and set the technical and documentation standard: every study written up with conclusions and next steps

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or related fields
Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or related fields is preferred
15+ years in semiconductor or optoelectronic reliability, failure analysis, or quality engineering, including leading a reliability function, team, or major qualification program
A proven track record taking a new technology from prototype through qualification into volume production — at least one program you can walk through end to end
Deep hands-on foundation: you have designed accelerated stress tests, done failure analysis, and built lifetime models, and can still work the data directly
Statistical fluency: time-to-failure distributions (Weibull, lognormal), acceleration modeling (Arrhenius, Peck), sample size and confidence planning, lifetime projection to use conditions
Rigor in experimental design and execution: controls, sample structure, stress levels, readpoints, and the discipline to hold a study to its plan
Experience with novel device technologies or material sets with undocumented failure modes — worked from first principles rather than an established qual flow
Experience translating customer mission profiles into qualification plans and lifetime requirements
Experience owning qualification at both component and module/system level
Working knowledge of JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q102, and ISO, and the judgment to adapt them to devices they were not written for
Experience presenting qualification data directly to external customers and their quality organizations
Outstanding written and verbal communication; disciplined about documenting work
Intellectual curiosity and ownership: you think about what can fail constantly, and you dig until you understand why
Background in liquid crystal devices (LCoS, displays), MEMS, image sensors, or photonics is preferred
Automotive or industrial qualification experience where your data was audited by a customer is preferred
Experience building a reliability function from a small team, defining process where none existed is preferred
Experience running split-lot DOEs with wafer fabs or materials vendors to improve intrinsic reliability is preferred
Experience defining burn-in and production screening for early-failure elimination is preferred
Experience with lidar, 3D sensing, or optical modules and their system-level tradeoffs is preferred

jobs.title: VP, Technology & AI
jobs.description:
The VP, Technology & AI (T&AI)
is a newly created leadership position at Woodruff. We’re looking for a transparent, innovative and results-driven leader with a diverse background to lead our technology vision and delivery capabilities within our T&AI core strength.

This role is responsible for advancing how technology, with an emphasis on AI, enhances both client outcomes and agency operations. By combining deep technical expertise with a forward-looking perspective on emerging technologies, this role ensures the agency remains at the forefront of digital experience development, automation, integration, quality assurance and AI-driven innovation.

This leader plays a key role in evaluating and implementing AI initiatives that improve efficiency, expand service offerings and create competitive advantage. The ideal candidate will partner closely with other agency leadership and cross-functional teams to shape future capabilities, establish best practices and foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

The VP of technology & AI will be a member of Woodruff’s leadership team, working closely with them to drive forward-thinking strategies and impactful technology solutions in order to achieve our goals and build a strong business and culture of trust. This person will also be responsible for building, mentoring and developing high-performing technology teams, ensuring technology strengths continue to evolve and drive long-term agency success.

This person must be located in the Kansas City or Columbia, MO, area.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Technology & AI Leadership

Define and lead the agency's technology and AI vision and roadmap, ensuring investments align with client needs and future growth opportunities
Establish and champion the agency's AI strategy, identifying where and how AI can create value across internal operations, client work, workflows and service offerings

jobs.description:
Research Technology Management – Vice President, AI Enablement Lead (Alpharetta)

Morgan Stanley Global Research is seeking a Vice President to serve as AI Enablement Lead within the Research Technology Management (RTM) organization. The AI Enablement Lead will be responsible for driving the practical adoption, development, governance, and optimization of generative AI and related AI capabilities across Global Research.

The role will lead the department’s dedicated AI Enablement team, currently comprising five Prompt Engineers and four Annotators, and will operate at the intersection of Research, technology, data, AI/modeling, product management, training, and governance.

The AI Enablement Lead will be responsible for translating the needs of Global Research analysts and teams into scalable, compliant, high-value AI solutions. The role will oversee the complete enablement lifecycle—from identifying and prioritizing use cases through requirements definition, solution development, evaluation, deployment, adoption, measurement, and ongoing support.

The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial services and investment research workflows with hands-on AI and technical capabilities, product and project management experience, and demonstrated leadership skills. The individual must be comfortable operating both strategically and tactically: establishing an AI enablement framework and roadmap for the department while also contributing directly to solution design, prompt development, testing, evaluation, and implementation.

Responsible for executing and shaping AI adoption strategy for Global Research, identifying and prioritizing high-value use cases and building a roadmap that improves analyst workflows, productivity, and research processes, defining the optimal balance of centrally developed tools vs custom solutions, team enablement and support of teams with ready-to-deploy AI assets.
Lead the AI Enablement team (5 Prompt Engineers, 4 Annotators), setting priorities, managing delivery, developing talent, and driving best practices across generative AI initiatives.
Translate Research needs into AI solutions, partnering with analysts, technology, data, and product teams to design, deploy, evaluate, and support scalable AI tools, prompts, and workflows.
Drive AI governance and compliance, ensuring all AI solutions meet legal, risk, model governance, information security, and regulatory requirements within a highly controlled environment.
Serve as the AI subject matter expert for Research, evaluating emerging AI technologies, optimizing platform/model usage, and advising stakeholders on the most effective applications of generative AI.
Lead training, change management, and measurement efforts, increasing AI adoption through education, best practices, KPI tracking, user feedback, and reporting on business impact to senior leadership.

Ideal Background

5-10+ years in financial services, investment research, fintech, or related fields.
Strong understanding of financial markets and research workflows.
Hands-on experience with generative AI, prompt engineering, and Python.
Proven team leadership, product/project management, and stakeholder management experience.
Ability to bridge business, technology, and governance functions while driving enterprise AI initiatives.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Delivery Senior Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Senior Manager you will lead client-facing cloud infrastructure and operations work within our Advisory practice, focusing on Amazon Web Services solutions that support platform design, deployment, and ongoing operations. As a Senior Manager you will bring strategic judgment, guide complex workstreams, coach teams through ambiguity, and communicate clear direction to stakeholders while balancing delivery priorities and service expectations. In this role at PwC, you will help shape secure, scalable cloud and network architecture solutions, drawing on your AWS knowledge, infrastructure operations background, and ability to translate technical needs into practical actions for clients.

In this role, you will be working within the Cloud Engineering, Data & Analytics network. You will design and build scalable and secure technology platforms, enabling insight-driven decision-making. Your ability to craft and convey clear, impactful messages and apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems will be crucial. This position offers the opportunity to deepen your skills and evolve your professional growth, contributing to the overall success of our firm.

Responsibilities

Leading cloud infrastructure and network architecture workstreams for AWS deployment initiatives across client environments
Designing scalable cloud platforms, virtualization layers, and network connectivity models that support secure application delivery
Assessing current-state infrastructure, identifying architecture gaps, and translating findings into migration and modernization plans
Advising clients on AWS landing zones, cloud strategy, and infrastructure patterns aligned to business and technical requirements
Directing implementation of cloud networking, firewall controls, access protocols, and security performance tuning activities
Applying architecture frameworks, enterprise integration concepts, and infrastructure design methods to solve cross-platform challenges
Guiding teams through delivery issues, validating technical outcomes, and incorporating client feedback into solution design
Coaching team members on cloud engineering methods, delivery planning, and operational discipline across multiple workstreams
Communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs to client stakeholders and internal leadership in clear terms

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure delivery, including 2 or more years leading AWS work at enterprise scale

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering
At least one of the following: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional preferred; AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or relevant AWS Specialty certification
Master's of Science or an MBA is preferred
Leveraging AWS partner programs and funding mechanisms, including MAP, Enterprise Discount Programs, and private pricing, to support client strategy and solution economics
Applying deep industry knowledge to shape cloud transformation strategies and solutions
Demonstrating AWS cloud infrastructure architecture across complex client environments
Leading cloud operations and platform engineering initiatives
Crafting client-ready messages and coaching teams through ambiguity

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws.
