jobs.title: Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About The Role

St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is seeking an experienced and strategic leader to manage and advance the institution's research storage ecosystem. As the Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure within Research Information Services (RIS), you will lead the team responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance data infrastructure that supports world-class biomedical research, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and high-performance computing.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for St. Jude's scientific computing storage environment, encompassing active research storage, archival and object storage, cloud-integrated platforms, secure research environments, data protection services, and disaster recovery capabilities. You will define technology strategy, guide platform evolution, oversee major investments, and ensure operational excellence across systems that store and protect some of the institution's most valuable research assets.

Working closely with Information Services teams, research programs, administrative leadership, and external collaborators, you will serve as a trusted advisor on storage architecture, research computing operations, service quality, capacity planning, and technology roadmaps. The position also plays a critical role in aligning infrastructure capabilities with evolving scientific and institutional priorities.

A key responsibility of this role is managing strategic vendor partnerships, including operational governance, architecture reviews, service delivery management, procurement support, technology evaluations, and performance accountability. As the primary institutional representative for research storage platforms, you will ensure effective coordination among St. Jude stakeholders, technology partners, and the broader research community.

The successful candidate will oversee infrastructure supporting AI training and inference, high-performance computing, genomics, imaging, scientific instrumentation, and other data-intensive research workloads while maintaining robust business continuity, backup, and disaster recovery capabilities for mission-critical research services.

What You Will Do:

Storage Strategy & Architecture:

Develop and manage the roadmap for St. Jude’s centralized research storage platforms, including high-performance file systems, object storage, archival storage, cloud-integrated storage, and secure research environments.
Lead architecture planning for future growth associated with AI, machine learning, scientific computing, research instrumentation, and emerging research technologies.
Evaluate new technologies and vendor solutions to improve performance, resilience, scalability, user experience, and cost efficiency.
Support institutional planning for significant increases in research data volume and complexity.

Operations & Service Delivery:

Ensure reliable operation of research storage services supporting HPC, AI, regulated research environments, institutional applications, and data-intensive science.
Establish and monitor service-level objectives, operational metrics, capacity forecasts, and performance benchmarks.
Develop reporting and dashboards to support leadership decision-making, budgeting, procurement, and lifecycle planning.
Lead incident management, root-cause analysis, change management, and continuous service improvement activities.
Document procedures and operational knowledge to support transparency and transfer across the institution and to new staff as well as updating and supporting centralized asset management and information security.

Vendor & Partner Management:

Serve as the primary relationship manager for storage vendors.
Lead governance meetings, technical reviews, architecture planning sessions, and service performance assessments.
Review equipment proposals, quotations, statements of work, and technology recommendations.
Define RACI models, escalation processes, and operational responsibilities across internal teams and service providers.

Research Data Management & Governance:

Partner with researchers, data stewards, and RIS leadership to align storage services with institutional data management objectives.
Support storage governance, archival processes, retention strategies, and lifecycle management activities.
Collaborate with Information Security and compliance partners to ensure appropriate controls for sensitive and regulated research data.
Promote data stewardship, efficient resource utilization, and sustainable storage growth.

Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity & Cyber Resilience:

Develop and maintain storage-related disaster recovery and business continuity strategies supporting institutional recovery objectives.
Ensure storage platforms are designed with resiliency, recoverability, backup, replication, immutable recovery, and cyber resilience capabilities.
Partner with Information Security, Technology Services, and RIS leadership to define recovery objectives, recovery procedures, and operational response plans.
Lead disaster recovery testing, recovery validation exercises, and documentation reviews.
Maintain architecture and operational documentation supporting audit readiness, business continuity, and disaster recovery requirements.
Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with storage infrastructure, vendor dependencies, capacity constraints, and emerging technologies.

Leadership & Team Development:

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of storage engineers, infrastructure specialists, and trusted consultants.
Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, innovation, collaboration, and customer service.
Support hiring, performance management, career development, succession planning, and workforce growth.
Build strong partnerships across RIS, Technology Services, Information Security, Shared Resources, and the research community.

Qualifications:

Required Education:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in business administration, computer science, data science, information science or related field.

Required Experience:

8+ years of progressive IT experience with experience managing small/mid-size teams, preferably enterprise-scale storage infrastructure, research computing environments, or large-scale data platforms.
Experience leading complex projects/delivery in terms of resources, vendors and budgets.
Experience managing teams in a supervisory/ leadership capacity, preferably 3+ years of experience leading technical teams or infrastructure operations.
Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role.

Highly Preferred Experience:

Experience managing storage technologies across on-premises, colocation, and/or cloud environments.
Experience working with storage vendors, managed service providers, or strategic technology partners.
Strong understanding of storage architecture, capacity planning, backup, replication, data protection, disaster recovery, business continuity, on-premises and cloud data storage, and performance optimization.
Demonstrated success leading operational service delivery and infrastructure lifecycle management.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Experience:

Experience supporting high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), scientific computing, or large-scale research environments.
Experience administering or supporting IBM Storage Scale (GPFS), Lustre, or comparable parallel file systems.
Familiarity with object storage platforms and S3-compatible architectures.
Experience designing and operating multi-tiered storage ecosystems spanning flash, disk, archive, cloud, and replication tiers.
Knowledge of leveraging local NVMe resources, burst buffers, caching layers, or node-local storage to accelerate AI and HPC workloads.
Experience supporting genomics, imaging, microscopy, or other high-throughput research data pipelines.
Experience with storage benchmarking, observability platforms, telemetry, and capacity forecasting.
Knowledge of disaster recovery, business continuity, cyber resilience, and data protection frameworks.
Experience supporting GPU computing, distributed AI training, and large-scale analytics platforms.

Compensation

In recognition of certain U.S. state and municipal pay transparency laws, St. Jude is including a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This is an estimate offered in good faith and a specific salary offer takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the salary range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is $125,840 - $238,160 per year for the role of Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure.

Explore our exceptional benefits!

We are committed to a human-centered hiring experience. Technology may support portions of our process, but recruiting decisions involve human review and engagement. Learn more about our approach to AI.

St. Jude is an Equal Opportunity Employer

No Search Firms

St. Jude Children's Research Hospital does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. Please do not call or email. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee or other representative at St. Jude via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place and approved by HR will result in no fee being paid in the event the candidate is hired by St. Jude.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Delivery Senior Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Senior Manager you will lead client-facing cloud infrastructure and operations work within our Advisory practice, focusing on Amazon Web Services solutions that support platform design, deployment, and ongoing operations. As a Senior Manager you will bring strategic judgment, guide complex workstreams, coach teams through ambiguity, and communicate clear direction to stakeholders while balancing delivery priorities and service expectations. In this role at PwC, you will help shape secure, scalable cloud and network architecture solutions, drawing on your AWS knowledge, infrastructure operations background, and ability to translate technical needs into practical actions for clients.

In this role, you will be working within the Cloud Engineering, Data & Analytics network. You will design and build scalable and secure technology platforms, enabling insight-driven decision-making. Your ability to craft and convey clear, impactful messages and apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems will be crucial. This position offers the opportunity to deepen your skills and evolve your professional growth, contributing to the overall success of our firm.

Responsibilities

Leading cloud infrastructure and network architecture workstreams for AWS deployment initiatives across client environments
Designing scalable cloud platforms, virtualization layers, and network connectivity models that support secure application delivery
Assessing current-state infrastructure, identifying architecture gaps, and translating findings into migration and modernization plans
Advising clients on AWS landing zones, cloud strategy, and infrastructure patterns aligned to business and technical requirements
Directing implementation of cloud networking, firewall controls, access protocols, and security performance tuning activities
Applying architecture frameworks, enterprise integration concepts, and infrastructure design methods to solve cross-platform challenges
Guiding teams through delivery issues, validating technical outcomes, and incorporating client feedback into solution design
Coaching team members on cloud engineering methods, delivery planning, and operational discipline across multiple workstreams
Communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs to client stakeholders and internal leadership in clear terms

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure delivery, including 2 or more years leading AWS work at enterprise scale

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering
At least one of the following: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional preferred; AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or relevant AWS Specialty certification
Master's of Science or an MBA is preferred
Leveraging AWS partner programs and funding mechanisms, including MAP, Enterprise Discount Programs, and private pricing, to support client strategy and solution economics
Applying deep industry knowledge to shape cloud transformation strategies and solutions
Demonstrating AWS cloud infrastructure architecture across complex client environments
Leading cloud operations and platform engineering initiatives
Crafting client-ready messages and coaching teams through ambiguity

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Delivery Director
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As an Amazon Web Services, Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Director, you will lead client engagements focused on cloud infrastructure and network architecture, shaping solutions that streamline integration, improve connectivity, and support technology performance. As a Director you will set strategic direction, drive business growth, and guide executive-level relationships while mentoring teams and promoting a culture where quality, integrity, inclusion, and commercial thinking guide decision-making. In this role at PwC, you will bring together cloud architecture, AWS deployment, IT operations, and network design to help clients modernize infrastructure, resolve complex technical challenges, and move technology programs forward within our Advisory practice.

In this role at PwC, you will be instrumental in driving business growth and shaping client engagements.You will foster environments where people and technology thrive together, promoting technological advances and creating a healthy working environment. Your leadership will be crucial in mentoring the next generation of leaders, upholding PwC's reputation for quality, integrity, and inclusion. You will identify gaps in the market and convert opportunities into success for the firm, all while adhering to professional and technical standards.

Responsibilities

Leading AWS cloud infrastructure and network architecture engagements from strategy through delivery
Shaping client technology roadmaps and defining target states for cloud and platform transformation
Developing AWS-based infrastructure designs across compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and security controls
Directing migration planning, platform modernization, and network integration activities across complex environments
Reviewing architecture frameworks, technical designs, and operating models to align with client goals
Guiding IT operations, service management, and troubleshooting activities for cloud and network platforms
Identifying opportunities to apply AWS services, cloud computing, and DevOps practices to improve delivery outcomes
Coaching teams on platform engineering, architecture decisions, and technical issue resolution
Building executive-level client relationships and advancing business development opportunities in the technology market
Driving collaboration across internal teams to shape scalable solutions for technology, media, and telecommunications clients

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience in cloud or infrastructure consulting with demonstrated AWS program leadership

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering
At least one of the following: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or Advanced AWS certifications
Master's of Science or an MBA is preferred
Demonstrated credibility within the AWS partner ecosystem
Achieving AWS competencies, specializations, or partner designations through prior alliance and capability-building efforts
Demonstrating industry expertise across cloud transformation and client delivery
Demonstrating AWS cloud infrastructure architecture design for client solutions
Leading cloud and network architecture initiatives across multiple engagements
Building executive client relationships and business growth opportunities
Mentoring teams while driving thought leadership and innovation

jobs.title: Director of IT Infrastructure (NCS) - BCIT
jobs.description:
THIS IS A NON-CIVIL SERVICE POSITION

Salary Range:

$122,569.00 - $202,068.00 Annually

Get to Know Us

Welcome to the City of Baltimore! Experience the reward of a fulfilling career and enjoy the added element of excitement in a vibrant, diverse atmosphere. The City of Baltimore offers limitless opportunities to help drive social impact, both on the job and in the community, while serving its citizens. Join us in making Baltimore a great place to live and work. In the City of Baltimore, we hire great people and provide them with the skills and opportunities to grow toward their career aspirations. If you are looking for a career change or interested in learning more, explore our opportunities and benefits programs. We are excited to have you as a part of the City of Baltimore Team! The city offers medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, optional life, AD&D, and FSA plans. This office also supplies wellness programs, support groups, and workshops. You can learn about our benefits here: https://humanresources.baltimorecity.gov/hr-divisions/benefits

Job Summary

The Director, Infrastructure serves as the senior leader responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of Baltimore City’s enterprise technology environment, overseeing data centers, network and cloud infrastructure, Service Desk operations, desktop support, storage, and email services. This role drives the City’s hybrid cloud strategy, ensures 24/7 operational continuity, strengthens cybersecurity in partnership with the CISO, and leads modernization efforts that support agency operations citywide. The Director provides strategic planning, budget oversight, vendor and contract management, and cross‑functional leadership to ensure Baltimore’s technology foundation is resilient, cost‑effective, and aligned with long‑term IT priorities.

Essential Functions

Leadership & People Management

Lead all supervisory functions: recruiting, hiring, staffing plans, performance management, training, conflict resolution, and corrective actions.
Represent BCIT to senior leadership, delivering regular updates on infrastructure performance, key projects, and issue resolution.
Build a culture of collaboration and shared accountability—no finger-pointing, just problem-solving.

Infrastructure Operations

Ensure 24/7 reliability through system monitoring, backups, performance tuning, patching, and OS upgrades across all platforms.
Manage internet and network infrastructure, including firewall administration and around-the-clock connectivity support.
Direct Service Desk and desktop support to achieve high first-call resolution rates and effective ticket escalation.
Administer on-call schedules and participate in rotation as needed.

Security & Resilience

Partner with the CISO and security teams to align infrastructure operations with the City’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring network, endpoint, and data center environments meet current standards and compliance requirements.
Drive improvement of securing the infrastructure—including network segmentation, least-privilege access controls, and multi-factor authentication—to reduce the City’s attack surface and limit the impact of any security incident.
Lead infrastructure-level preparedness for cyber threats, including ransomware response planning, regular tabletop exercises, and ensuring backup and recovery systems are isolated, tested, and ready to execute.

Strategy & Planning

Develop infrastructure roadmaps and strategies aligned with agency needs and the City’s long-term technology vision.
Own the City’s hybrid cloud infrastructure strategy—defining standards for workload placement, managing cloud provider relationships, and ensuring on-premise and cloud environments are integrated, secure, and cost-effective.
Drive cloud cost optimization across the infrastructure portfolio, establishing governance around cloud spend, rightsizing resources, and identifying opportunities to consolidate or migrate workloads to reduce total cost of ownership.
Contribute to annual operating and capital budget planning; manage assigned budget with full accountability.
Participate in enterprise-wide strategic planning and multi-agency IT initiatives.
Monitor emerging technology trends and integrate best practices to continuously advance BCIT’s capabilities.

Procurement & Contract Management

Cultivate vendor relationships to maximize value from partner products and services.
Review citywide technology purchase requests to ensure compliance with BCIT standards and IT strategy.
Manage hardware and software procurement within budget, with proper justification and approval documentation.
Oversee infrastructure contracts: enforce terms, prevent unintended auto-renewals, and approve monthly invoices for leases, maintenance, and services.

Architecture & Service Delivery

Develop and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs) that set clear performance expectations for end users.
Partner with development teams and user groups to design effective IT architecture and drive timely issue resolution.
Maintain accurate, up-to-date asset inventory for all BCIT technology assets.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Have a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline preferred.

Relevant certifications are a plus: Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), AWS Solutions Architect, or Microsoft Azure Administrator.

Prior IT experience in a government environment is strongly preferred.

OR

Equivalency Notes:
Have an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. If a degree is unrelated to IT, specialized IT experience is required. Advanced technical certifications may substitute for up to six months of experience or education, and multiple certifications may receive additional credit.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

10+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure management, with a background in Enterprise Architecture, Systems or Network Architecture and Administration, or Data Center Operations and Management.
Deep expertise in enterprise architecture with the ability to evaluate and integrate complex solutions across functional areas.
Strong knowledge of ITIL frameworks, Change Management methodologies, and cybersecurity principles.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, drive complex projects, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Experience developing and executing Disaster Recovery plans, including tabletop exercises.
Demonstrated track record leading hybrid cloud infrastructure strategy and implementation (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) at enterprise scale, including cloud cost governance, FinOps practices, and workload optimization.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills—able to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization.
Ability to perform technology gap analysis, identify opportunities, and propose enterprise-level solutions.
Working knowledge of AI technologies, frameworks, and ethical considerations, with the ability to identify opportunities for innovation.
Deep understanding of modern cybersecurity frameworks and practices—including zero trust architecture, network segmentation, endpoint security, and least-privilege access controls—with demonstrated experience partnering with CISO or security functions to drive infrastructure-level security strategy.
Experience managing infrastructure vendor relationships and contracts, including procurement governance, SLA enforcement, renewal pipeline management, and invoice oversight for leases and maintenance agreements.

Additional Information

Background Check

Eligible candidates under final consideration for appointment to positions identified as positions of trust will be required to complete authorization for a Criminal Background Check and/or Fingerprint must be successfully completed.

Probation

All persons, including current City employees, selected for this position must complete a mandatory six-month/1-year probation.

Financial Disclosure

This position is required to complete a Financial Disclosure pursuant to Sections 7-7, 7-8, and 7-9 of the City Ethics Law. T he initial financial disclosure must be submitted within 30 days of hire.

Baltimore City Government is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. The City of Baltimore prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, ancestry, creed, national origin, disability status, genetics, marital status, military service, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Applicants requiring accommodations during the hiring process should contact the Department of Human Resources directly. Do not attach your request for accommodation to the application.

jobs.description:
About GameChanger

We believe in the life changing impact youth sports have on and off the field. Sports encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence – important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.

So if you love sports and their community building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

The Position

Our Basketball engineering organization is building and scaling the products that will help GameChanger grow in the most-played youth sport in the country. Within that org, the Coverage team owns the core experience of getting every game onto the platform: scorekeeping, live video capture, and the coaching tools built on top of that data.

As a Senior Engineering Manager on this team, you will lead a cross-functional group of engineers working across iOS, Android, and backend platforms, partnering closely with Product and Design to make covering a game as fast, reliable, and low-friction as possible. You will report to the Director of Engineering for Basketball.

What You'll Do

Coach and develop your engineers, setting clear expectations, identifying growth-oriented opportunities, and establishing a consistent cadence of feedback that fosters both development and accountability.
Define clear delivery goals for your team, partnering with cross-functional partners to shape priorities, navigate trade-offs and surface risks before they become problems.
Set and hold a consistent bar for engineering craft and system reliability, especially around live, in-game workflows where failures are highly visible to users on the sideline.
Hire and onboard strong engineers, keeping the bar high on values alignment, skill fit, and AI fluency.
Contribute to engineering culture and organizational effectiveness beyond your team through cross-team initiatives and helping shape how the broader org operates.

Who You Are

4+ years leading engineering teams and 6+ years of software development experience, with a track record of managing and growing engineering talent at all levels.
You have technical depth in one or more areas of our stack, with enough breadth to engage credibly in architecture conversations, hold a consistent standard for quality and reliability, and maintain the trust of senior engineers.
You have good product instincts, build strong working relationships with Product and Design partners, and know how to align on priorities in a way that drives meaningful outcomes.
You are active in developing your own AI fluency and in helping your team do the same. You hold a high bar for judgment and ownership regardless of how code gets written.

Perks

Work remotely throughout the US* or from our well-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY.
Unlimited vacation policy.
Paid volunteer opportunities.
Technology stipend - $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology.
WFH stipend - $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable.
Monthly physical, mental, wellness & learning stipend offered through Holisticly.
Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe.
Full health benefits - medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents.
Retirement savings - Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match.
Life insurance - basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life.
Disability leave - short-term disability and long-term disability.
Company paid parental leave - up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents.
Family building benefits offered through Progyny.
DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount.

Summary

The Director, Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, modernization, and ongoing support of enterprise technology solutions that enable the firm’s legal and business operations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for software engineering, application development, and systems integration, and engineering delivery functions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable and aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities.

The Director, Engineering partners closely with value stream leadership, IT services leaders, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality technology capabilities that improve attorney and business professional productivity, enhance client experience, and support revenue growth and operational efficiency.

This role is accountable for engineering execution discipline, technical quality, delivery reliability, and the evolution of reusable engineering and platform capabilities that accelerate the firm's transition to a build-capable technology organization.

About Shipwell

At Shipwell, we are transforming logistics by turning supply chains into intelligent systems of action. We empower shippers to achieve unprecedented efficiency and service effectiveness at scale by putting artificial intelligence and automation to work. The Shipwell platform democratizes technology that was previously out of reach for many, combining transportation management (TMS), real-time multimodal visibility, procurement, and advanced machine learning into one comprehensive, intuitive solution. By leveraging autonomous digital agents—such as our Track & Trace AI Worker and natural-language AI Assistants—Shipwell automates the manual tasks that slow operations down. Built to adapt and scale alongside changing business demands, our platform enables shippers to proactively resolve freight exceptions, optimize costs, and manage the entire shipping process seamlessly.
As Shipwell celebrates a decade of innovation, industry experts continue to recognize our market traction and distinguish us as a leading force in modern logistics technology. Highlighting this evolution, Shipwell was recently named a "Visionary" in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Transportation Management Systems (advancing from previous recognitions in 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024). In 2026, the platform also won "Transport Management Platform of the Year" from SupplyTech Breakthrough and was named to the Inbound Logistics Top 100 Logistics & Supply Chain Technology List. These latest honors join a rich history of awards, including being named the fourth fastest-growing company in North America on the 2021, 2022, and 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500, winning FreightWaves’ 2021 and 2022 FreightTech Awards for Innovation and Disruption, earning Food Logistics’ 2022 Top Software & Technology Provider, and being recognized as a 2020 Forbes Next Billion-Dollar Startup.

Our Culture

Shipwell is a fast-paced, high-energy start-up that strives to build the future of shipping every day. Diversity of thought and cross-department collaboration is very important to us. We deliver open, honest, careful communication and work as hard as we play. We create & deliver solutions that are revolutionizing the industry, which brings excitement and purpose to our work. If you are looking for a place that will help you tap into your best work-self and give you hands-on experience building something big, then we invite you to come and build the future of shipping with us!

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is energetic and has a passion for building leading-edge software. Execute and continue to evolve the R&D department’s AI strategy incorporating industry best practices and new technology innovation to continue to increase engineering and process efficiencies through AI technology

Oversee planning, execution, governance, risks, dependencies, and resource allocation for strategic technology and AI initiatives across the product portfolio
Stay current on industry advancements across models, agent orchestration, best practices and other emerging technology innovations
Promote a SMART codebase (Simple, Maintainable, Agile, Refactored and Tested) for a SAFE product (Secure, Available, Fast and Easy).

Position title: Director of Engineering

About Our Transition To Ondas Sentinel

World View was recently acquired by Ondas Inc. (NASDAQ: ONDS) and, together with DZYNE Technologies, has joined forces to create Ondas Sentinel. Ondas Sentinel is a next-generation U.S. defense platform integrating long-endurance ISR, autonomous systems, counter-UAS technologies, and mission intelligence.

While World View is now part of Ondas Sentinel, we are still legally operating as World View as we complete the formal integration of our systems and processes. As a result, you may see roles cross-posted across DZYNE and World View, during this transition. All positions represent opportunities within the same combined organization.

What does this mean for candidates?

You’re joining a team that is accelerating the future of autonomous defense
You’ll be part of a company backed by significant investment, strong growth, and mission-proven technology
You’ll work alongside world-class engineers and innovators who have already delivered thousands of operational flight hours, high-impact ISR capabilities, leading counter-UAS systems, and breakthrough autonomous effects
You’ll help shape a unified platform that enables operators to see more, decide faster, and act with confidence across the modern battlespace

Together, Ondas Sentinel is building something bigger than any one company, a scalable, integrated defense organization designed to meet emerging mission needs with speed, precision, and purpose.

If you’re energized by ambitious missions, rapid innovation, and a chance to help define the future of autonomous defense, we’d love to have you on the team.

Role Overview

The Director of Engineering is a senior technical and people leadership role responsible for leading the engineering organization while providing technical oversight across all Stratospheric ISR programs. This individual will establish engineering priorities, guide technical strategy, and lead multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete product development lifecycle—from concept development and system architecture through design, integration, verification, manufacturing, and operational deployment.

The ideal candidate combines deep systems engineering expertise with strong organizational leadership and a passion for developing high-performing teams. This role partners closely with Program Management, Operations, Manufacturing, Business Development, and executive leadership to deliver innovative, mission-critical aerospace systems.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering organization, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Establish engineering priorities and technical direction across multiple programs, ensuring alignment with company objectives and customer requirements
In partnership with the Chief Engineer, drive technology identification, assessment, application, and maturation roadmaps in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
Lead systems architecture, requirements development, and design activities for new platforms, payloads, software, ground systems, and supporting technologies
Provide technical oversight throughout the full system development lifecycle, including concept development, detailed design, integration, verification, validation, production, and sustainment
Oversee prototype development and rapid technology demonstrations to accelerate capability maturation and customer adoption
Define engineering execution plans, monitor technical performance, manage development costs, and ensure successful program execution
Implement project management processes and engineering metrics to monitor schedules, technical progress, risks, and resource utilization
Serve as the senior technical interface with customers, government stakeholders, strategic partners, and suppliers, providing technical leadership and innovative solutions
Lead the development and maintenance of system, subsystem, and component requirements while ensuring complete requirements traceability
Direct the creation and maintenance of technical documentation to support efficient program execution, configuration management, and compliance
Lead major technical reviews including System Requirements Reviews (SRR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Functional Configuration Audits (FCA), and other engineering milestone reviews
Coordinate system verification and validation activities to ensure products satisfy technical, operational, contractual, and regulatory requirements
Partner closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations, and Program Management to ensure successful transition from development into production and operational deployment
Promote engineering best practices, continuous process improvement, and disciplined systems engineering methodologies across the organization

Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree and preferred MS
15+ years of progressive engineering experience developing complex, integrated aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems
Minimum of 5 years of engineering management experience leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations
Demonstrated experience with systems engineering for complex platforms, including vehicles, payloads, command and control systems, ground systems, and supporting infrastructure
Experience leading products through the complete engineering lifecycle from concept through production and operational deployment
Strong understanding of systems architecture, requirements management, integration, verification, validation, and configuration management
Experience managing engineering budgets, schedules, technical risk, and resource planning
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and successfully deliver technically complex programs
Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence technical direction across multiple organizations
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance, if required

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering or related technical field
Experience with high-altitude platforms, aerospace vehicles, unmanned systems, ISR technologies, or defense systems
Experience with rapid prototyping and technology demonstrations
Familiarity with Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs), Manufacturing Readiness Levels (MRLs), and technology maturation processes
Experience supporting Department of Defense or government programs
Knowledge of aerospace quality systems, manufacturing development, and test engineering methodologies
Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and scaling high-performing engineering organizations

What We Offer

You will work side by side with experts in emerging technology, gaining exposure to cutting edge ideas and projects that are shaping the future. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance because we believe in taking care of the you as a person, not just a team member.

Our Tucson workplace is designed to support collaboration, focus, and well-being, with an on-site environment that keeps supply chain, manufacturing, engineering, quality, and program teams closely connected to the mission.

We believe in creating a dynamic and inclusive workplace where creativity thrives, and every voice is heard. Our commitment to all team members is built upon five core cultural pillars: Engage, Lean In, Create, Care, and Own. Together, these pillars form the foundation of our employee experience while adhering to the highest standards of ethical and sustainable practices.

Some Final Notes

The description gives you a sense of what the position involves but is not an exhaustive list. We are a growing and evolving team, which means your responsibilities may shift or expand over time as new opportunities arise. Flexibility and curiosity are part of what makes our work exciting!

At Ondas Sentinel, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate belonging and diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from every background and life experience because we know our differences make us stronger.

THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

As the Infrastructure Engineering Director, you'll own FanDuel's foundational cloud and outpost-based infrastructure layer. You'll establish operational excellence, standardization, and reliability across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and cloud provisioning that everything else runs on. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you set the standard for how infrastructure operates, not just keeping systems running but making them run predictably, with clear processes, documented procedures, and a culture that values doing things right.

This role lands at a critical juncture. FanDuel is scaling rapidly across new markets and cloud footprints. Your infrastructure foundation must handle that growth without creating operational chaos or cost surprises. You'll drive standardization (provisioning, observability, disaster recovery, cost attribution), establish discipline (operational runbooks, change management, incident response), and build an infrastructure team that operates with rigor and purpose. You'll manage vendor relationships, own cloud spend and capacity planning, and balance cost optimization with reliability and resilience.

By connecting infrastructure behavior to real business impact, you'll drive improvements in reliability, performance, cost, and operational maturity. You'll partner closely with Platform Engineering leadership and product teams to ensure our foundation actually supports what they need to build.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

THE GAME PLAN

Everyone on our team has a part to play

Establishing infrastructure strategy and standards across cloud provisioning, observability, disaster recovery, and cost governance. Standardization removes ambiguity and makes operations safer and faster.
Building and scaling the infrastructure engineering team with operational rigor and discipline. Hiring for people who care about documentation, reliability, and unglamorous work. Creating career paths and developing infrastructure engineers into senior and leadership roles.
Owning disaster recovery strategy, RTO/RPO definitions, testing, and organizational readiness. If DR hasn't been tested, it doesn't exist.
Establishing SLOs/SLIs for foundational infrastructure services. Making clear tradeoffs between cost optimization and reliability; these aren't opposing goals but they require transparency.
Designing and evolving cloud infrastructure for resilience, cost, and operational clarity. Managing AWS, outposts, Kubernetes orchestration, networking, mesh, and compute provisioning.
Setting standards for operational discipline: change management, incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement. Protecting infrastructure engineers from burnout while celebrating unglamorous work.
Managing vendor relationships, cloud costs, and capacity planning. Owning the business relationship with infrastructure: negotiating contracts, optimizing spend, planning cloud adoption roadmap.
Leading complex production incident response across infrastructure domains: Kubernetes, networking, DNS, load balancing, service mesh, cloud services.
Stewarding infrastructure platforms operating under strict regulatory and compliance requirements. Ensuring secure operation, auditability, and disciplined change management.
Partnering with engineering and product leadership to influence platform direction, roadmap priorities, and long-term infrastructure strategy.
Evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and vendor capabilities against infrastructure requirements and operational sustainability goals.
Mentoring engineers and raising infrastructure, platform networking, and operational maturity across the organization.

A Sneak Peek Into Our Tech Stack

AWS (including Outposts), Kubernetes (EKS, 100+ clusters) , Kong Gateway & Kong Mesh, Terraform, Helm and Datadog

THE STATS

What we're looking for in our next teammate

Significant experience leading platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure organizations.
Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, operations, and scaling. Working knowledge of container orchestration, cluster design, workload isolation, and multi-cluster management.
Strong hands-on understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure: VPCs, networking, IAM, EC2, EKS, cost management, and operating hybrid AWS environments including Outposts.
Experience defining and driving platform, reliability, or infrastructure strategy across teams, with the ability to influence technical direction and set standards.
Proven ability to establish operational discipline: documented runbooks, change management processes, incident response frameworks, and blameless post-mortem culture.
Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery, RTO/RPO definitions, failover testing, and resilience improvements across production systems.
Experience defining and implementing SLOs, SLIs, and alerting strategies for infrastructure services using user-centric and business-aligned metrics.
Strong software engineering fundamentals with proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Ability to build scalable tooling and automation.
Track record of driving large-scale operational improvements through automation, reducing organizational toil, and preventing recurring classes of issues.
Understanding of cloud cost drivers and the ability to optimize spend without sacrificing reliability, resilience, or team velocity.
Strong analytical and communication skills. Ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. Can translate infrastructure constraints into business and customer impact.
A mindset of ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term platform sustainability. You know when standards are working and when they need to change.

Bonus

Experience with service mesh platforms (Kong Mesh, Istio, Linkerd, or Envoy-based systems).
Hands-on experience managing AWS Outposts or hybrid cloud infrastructure.
Experience operating infrastructure in regulated industries where network segmentation, auditability, security controls and uptime are critical.
CNCF Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKS, CKAD).
Familiarity with observability platforms like Datadog, Prometheus, and tracing systems.

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. new_jobs.description:
About Us

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description

As Vice President of Software Engineering for our Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) portfolio, you will lead a global organization of engineers across multiple product lines that finance teams rely on to plan, close, consolidate and report. You will own how that portfolio is built, shipped and run.

2027 is a transformation year. We are modernizing established applications, building new SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities, moving to an agentic software development lifecycle, and putting AI directly into the hands of our customers. We need a leader who can deliver all four at once without compromising the quality and reliability our customers depend on for their most critical financial processes, and who measures success with the same discipline our customers apply to their numbers.

We enjoy our work as much as we enjoy working together, and we want leaders who get things done while having a positive influence on our workplace environment.

What You Will Deliver In 2027

Modernize legacy applications
Define and execute a modernization strategy for the EPM portfolio, choosing deliberately between re-platform, re-architect, strangler-pattern migration, and retirement for each product and component
Sequence modernization to deliver customer value incrementally, avoiding big-bang rewrites and protecting customers already in production
Reduce technical debt measurably, with a visible debt register, investment targets and progress reported to executive leadership
Plan and execute customer migrations from on-premise and single-tenant deployments with clear data-integrity, cutover and rollback plans
Build SaaS and multi-tenant capabilities
Lead the design and delivery of cloud-native, multi-tenant services, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, configuration and extensibility models
Build the shared platform capabilities that product teams rely on: identity, observability, metering, tenant provisioning, and self-service environments
Own SaaS operational excellence: SLOs and error budgets, on-call and incident management, capacity planning, cost efficiency, and disaster recovery
Embed security, privacy and compliance (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) into architecture and delivery pipelines rather than treating them as downstream gates
Deliver with an agentic SDLC
Lead the shift from AI-assisted coding to an agentic software development lifecycle, where AI agents participate in planning, coding, testing, code review, documentation and operations
Establish the guardrails that make this safe: human review policy, test and evaluation gates, provenance and traceability of AI-generated changes, and secure handling of code and data
Redesign team workflows, roles and skills for agentic delivery, and coach engineering managers and engineers through the change
Measure the impact rigorously, proving gains in flow, quality and reliability rather than tracking adoption alone
Build customer-facing AI features
Partner with Product to deliver AI capabilities that finance users trust, such as natural-language analysis, forecasting assistance, anomaly detection and agentic workflows across planning, close and reporting
Build the engineering foundations for production AI: model and prompt management, retrieval over governed financial data, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring for accuracy, drift and cost
Apply responsible-AI practices appropriate to financial data, including explainability, auditability, tenant data isolation, and clear human-in-the-loop controls
Ship AI features on the same delivery standards as the rest of the portfolio: tested, observable, reversible and measured against defined quality bars
Raise the bar on quality and DORA outcomes
Own engineering outcomes against the DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, failed deployment recovery time, and rework rate), with transparent baselines and quarterly improvement targets for every product line
Build quality in: test automation across the pyramid, continuous integration on every change, trunk-based development, feature flags, and progressive delivery
Make reliability a product feature through service-level objectives, error budgets that inform prioritization, and blameless post-incident reviews that lead to lasting fixes
Shift security left with automated scanning, dependency and vulnerability management, and secure-by-default pipelines

new_jobs.description:
About Tri Imaging Solutions

Tri Imaging Solutions has merged with DirectMed Imaging, uniting two trusted names in the medical imaging industry under one organization. Tri Imaging Solutions is our go-forward brand, so the Tri Imaging Solutions name and logo now represent our combined company. You may have found this opening on DirectMed Imaging's careers page or LinkedIn - it is the same team, and your application goes to the same place.

Founded in 2013 and headquartered just north of Nashville in Madison, TN, Tri Imaging Solutions helps healthcare providers keep their diagnostic imaging systems running - supplying quality-tested replacement parts, equipment, and nationwide service across CT, MRI, mammography, X-ray, and more. We are also home to an industry-leading training center on a mission to empower the engineer, and we are ISO 13485:2016 certified.

The Director of Clinical Engineering provides leadership for our comprehensive Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) service program for assigned hospital account(s), with a focus on optimizing equipment uptime, program compliance, and ensuring safety and performance in a cost-conscious, expeditious manner. The Director may also supervise the work of biomedical equipment technicians (BMETs), imaging service engineers (ISEs), supervisors, and other management, technical, and assigned personnel, and must be able to work with, train, and supervise others. The Director of Clinical Engineering functions in a team-based work environment and focuses on achieving team-based requirements and goals.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

The essential functions of the job include, but are not limited to, the following:

Customer Relations

Respond expeditiously to calls from clinical departments to evaluate and rectify valid operator complaints and concerns.
Organize and/or provide in-service educational programs on the use of equipment.
Maintain good working relationships with fellow workers, nursing and medical staff, vendors, manufacturers, and the general public.
Display effective customer service in accordance with the annual satisfaction survey protocol.

Operational Excellence

Demonstrate a strong work ethic and the ability to work as a member of a team.
Demonstrate and reflect a commitment to the mission and values of the company.
Manage the repair, installation, maintenance, calibration, and inspection of complex clinical equipment, instrumentation, and systems. Assign routine repairs, inspections, and installations to subordinates and observe their performance.
Manage planned maintenance and electrical safety testing of clinical equipment, devices, and systems, and monitor completion of planned maintenance performed by outside vendors.
Review the outcomes of planned maintenance actions and recommend improvements to department staff.
Supervise and instruct biomedical equipment maintenance personnel in the safe use, application, testing, planned maintenance, and repair of all types of clinical equipment technologies and systems.
Provide leadership and managerial oversight to direct reports, as assigned, maintaining optimum productivity, quality, and efficiency.
Provide input on client capital replacement strategies for medical equipment and its maintenance requirements.
Plan, organize, and direct the growth, effectiveness, and financial performance of the client contract in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Manage the equipment database (CMMS) and generate fail code, corrective maintenance, and planned maintenance completion reports.
Prepare, present, and explain CMMS reports to management as required.
Maintain an orderly and functional work environment, ensuring tools and test equipment are calibrated and in good working order before use.
Maintain compliance with the company's ISO 13485 certification standards and Quality Management Program (QMP) policies and requirements.
Work augmented shifts as needed to meet the client's contractual requirements.
When required, represent the company on hospital committees to ensure safe and effective equipment operation according to contract specifications.
Establish and administer the on-call schedule, and take on-call responsibilities as necessary.

Administration

Maintain accurate inventory and documentation of all equipment, inspections, repairs, and failures.
Research and initiate orders for repair parts within established budget parameters. Generate purchase orders and find second-source parts when the Technical Resource Center is not available.
Demonstrate good organization and time management skills.
Provide accurate and timely CMMS database management in accordance with the Quality Management System and related policies and procedures.
Learn, understand, and comply with all government, regulatory, industry, company, and client policies and procedures, including updates.
Complete all required training (e.g., skills-based, client, work-related, certification).
Manage disciplinary issues and other employee relations concerns with guidance from Human Resources, the Regional Director of Operations, and/or the Vice President.
Lead and report in accordance with corporate goals for growth, security, and continuity of the account agreement.
Complete annual employee performance evaluations, competency assessments, training plans, and merit increases on time.
Participate in the hiring process and help the company meet its affirmative action goals.
Perform other duties as assigned that are intrinsic to the successful operation of the account and company.

Education and Experience

Education:
Bachelor's degree in biomedical engineering or a related technical discipline required. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted. Certifications such as CHTM, CBET, or A+ are preferred.
Experience:

Minimum of seven (7) years servicing a broad range of clinical and patient care equipment in a hospital environment.
Minimum of five (5) years of leadership experience required.
Experience supervising on-site hospital technicians preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Ability to manage technical personnel with biomedical and/or imaging skill sets, as well as other technical, administrative, and management personnel as needed.
In-depth knowledge of electronic circuitry and the technical aspects of operating, repairing, and performing planned maintenance on electronic and electromechanical equipment.
Knowledge of basic anatomy, physiology, and medical terminology as applied to biomedical equipment.
Knowledge of networking theory, computer and server repair, and how they interface with clinical equipment.
Comprehensive knowledge of current regulatory requirements.
Ability to analyze, repair, and test electronic and electromechanical equipment.
Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and illustrated parts drawings of biomedical instrumentation.
Ability to train and mentor other technicians.
Ability to maintain accurate records of repairs, calibrations, and tests.
Ability to follow all applicable hospital and department policies, procedures, and standards.
Computer literacy, including email, spreadsheets, word processing, and the assigned CMMS.

Computers/Laptops:
For daily tasks, communication, and project management.

Larger or multiple screens for enhanced productivity.
Printers/Scanners:
For printing documents and scanning files.
Phones/Headsets:
For calls, meetings, and communication.

Tools like Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Zoom for team communication and meetings.
Office Software:
Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation and data management.
File Storage/Sharing:
Cloud platforms like Google Drive or OneDrive for file storage and collaboration.
Video Conferencing Tools:
Zoom or similar platforms for virtual meetings.

Job Summary

Freedom Power Systems, Inc., a 30 person, subsidiary of Vicor Corporation, is a leading designer and manufacturer of commercial mission-critical power systems for the aerospace and defense industries. We integrate Vicor’s advanced DC/DC converters, filters, and power circuits into complete, ruggedized power systems engineered for reliability, performance, and compliance.

We are seeking an experienced, execution-driven Vice President of Engineering to lead our engineering function and directly own project and program management execution. This role oversees a fully staffed engineering organization and is responsible for driving product development, system integration, sustaining engineering, compliance, schedule management, risk management, and disciplined program execution.

This position is 100% onsite at Cedar Park, TX

Job Description

Provide strategic and operational leadership for engineering while personally managing project and program execution.
Lead a multidisciplinary engineering team (electrical, mechanical, software/firmware, test, network).
Oversee the full product lifecycle: concept, design, prototyping, verification, qualification testing coordination, release, and sustaining.
Ensure adherence to AS9100/ISO 9001 design and development processes.
Own and actively manage program schedules, costs, risks, milestones, and cross-functional coordination.
Strengthen engineering processes, documentation, and design controls.
Partner with Operations and Quality to ensure manufacturability, compliance, and repeatability.
Support customer engagements and proposal development with technical expertise.

Education / Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of engineering leadership experience in aerospace, defense, power systems, or electromechanical systems.
Proven success leading engineering teams in a manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of system level integration involving power modules, converters, filters, thermal systems, and packaging.
Experience with regulatory and compliance standards (UL, MIL STD, FCC, CE, DO 160).
Demonstrated ability to personally manage projects and programs while delivering complex products on schedule.
Excellent communication, leadership, and decision making abilities.
This position requires access to information or technology that is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR."

Preferred Experience

Experience integrating modular power components.
Background in defense or aerospace product development and qualification.
Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and engineering change processes.
Experience leading established engineering teams through organizational growth.

Lead engineering and program management at a strategically important, defense-focused subsidiary of Vicor.
Guide a capable engineering team that needs strong leadership, not rebuilding.
Shape the future of mission critical power systems used in demanding aerospace and defense applications.
Competitive compensation, benefits, and long term growth opportunities.

new_jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a key member of the Reliability Architecture organization, the Director of Enterprise Observability Architecture provides strategic leadership for enterprise-wide observability initiatives, ensuring DTCC platforms and applications operate with regulatory-grade visibility, resilience, and operational continuity. This role defines the north-star observability vision, influences architectural direction, embeds telemetry and resilience into modernization programs, and partners with senior stakeholders across engineering, infrastructure, SRE, security, risk, and business operations. Aligned to DTCC’s mission of delivering secure and reliable market infrastructure, this role ensures observability capabilities (metrics, logs, traces, events, dashboards, data health, and automated remediation) are consistently designed, adopted, and governed across the enterprise.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Shape and champion DTCC’s enterprise observability strategy, ensuring alignment with operational resilience, business continuity, and regulatory expectations
Define multi-year roadmaps for observability modernization, including OpenTelemetry adoption, enhanced signal correlation, and AIOps-enablement
Establish enterprise-wide architectural standards, patterns, and controls for telemetry, monitoring, alerting, visualization, and retention
Drive platform-engineering approaches that deliver observability as a scalable, self-service capability for application and infrastructure teams
Ensure all critical production services are instrumented for real-time visibility that connects technical health to business impact
Influence senior leadership through clear communication of observability risks, maturity, and strategic investment options
Integrate data observability into analytics ecosystems to support regulatory reporting, risk analytics, and client-impact transparency
Guide engineering teams in embedding observability throughout the SDLC, including NFR testing, architecture reviews, and operational readiness
Lead the design of event-correlation and alerting frameworks that reduce noise, accelerate incident triage, and enable automated remediation
Define enterprise dashboards that provide 360° visibility into service reliability, transaction flows, and business-processing health
Maintain an enterprise observability architecture covering metrics, logs, traces, events, RUM, data pipelines, and telemetry governance
Author policies, standards, and procedures for monitoring, alerting, logging, visualization, and retention
Partner with platform, cloud, and infrastructure engineering to integrate observability into modernization and cloud-adoption strategies
Present architecture strategies and program health to senior technology and business leaders
Lead enterprise assessments, failure-mode analysis, chaos engineering practices, and post-incident improvement cycles
Translate telemetry insights into business-level narratives that inform risk, resilience, and operational decision-making

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above**

Qualifications

Minimum 10 years of related experience
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (preferred) or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business outcomes into technical architectures
Deep knowledge of observability patterns, resiliency engineering, and automated recovery pipelines
Expertise in hybrid-cloud and public cloud architectural design
Strong understanding of financial services regulatory expectations for operational resilience
Proficiency in Java, Linux, SQL, and scripting for prototyping and validation
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills
Familiarity with resilience and continuity frameworks (e.g., ISO 22301, NIST SP 800-34) and operational risk management

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience - shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win - clients, LPL, and most importantly our employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what's possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

Generate Interest

LPL Financial is seeking a visionary technology leader to drive the modernization and strategic evolution of critical Wealth Management and Brokerage platforms supporting Corporate Actions, Class Actions, and Securities Lending functions. As Vice President, Lead Software Engineer, you will lead large-scale transformation initiatives, influence enterprise technology strategy, and oversee the delivery of innovative solutions across a complex and evolving technology landscape.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a high-performing engineering organization, champion AI-assisted software development practices, and shape the future of cloud-native, event-driven platforms that support key business operations. You'll collaborate with executive leaders, business partners, architects, and engineering teams to drive technology innovation, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

Job Overview

The Vice President, Lead Software Engineer is responsible for technology strategy, architecture leadership, engineering delivery, and platform modernization across Corporate Actions, Class Actions, and Securities Lending platforms. This role provides leadership across more than 20 application teams and partners closely with Product, Operations, Architecture, Security, Data, Infrastructure, Compliance, and senior leadership stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient technology solutions that support enterprise priorities.

Responsibilities

Define and execute multi-year technology roadmaps supporting Corporate Actions, Class Actions, and Securities Lending platforms.
Lead modernization initiatives transitioning legacy systems to cloud-native, API-first, service-oriented, and event-driven architectures.
Establish architecture and engineering standards focused on scalability, resiliency, security, observability, and operational excellence.
Drive adoption of modern technologies including .NET, Angular, AWS, Kafka, microservices, enterprise integration patterns, and data platforms.
Champion AI-assisted software engineering practices across the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, documentation, automation, and production support.
Lead delivery of enterprise applications, advisor-facing solutions, APIs, cloud platforms, and strategic integrations.
Partner with senior business leaders, product management, operations teams, architects, and external vendors to align technology investments with business objectives.
Lead technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, vendor assessments, and modernization initiatives involving both vendor and internally developed platforms.
Establish and oversee engineering excellence practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, quality engineering, reliability engineering, security, and observability.
Monitor and drive engineering performance through key operational, delivery, reliability, quality, and productivity metrics.
Provide leadership, coaching, talent development, succession planning, and organizational growth across distributed engineering teams.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and client-focused delivery.

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements

15+ years of software engineering experience, including progressive leadership responsibility within enterprise technology organizations.
Experience leading large-scale modernization, digital transformation, and enterprise technology delivery programs.
Demonstrated expertise in cloud technologies, distributed systems, API and microservices architecture, DevSecOps practices, and modern software engineering methodologies.
Experience leading large engineering organizations, cross-functional teams, and strategic technology initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and vendor partners.
Experience communicating technology strategy, delivery plans, and business outcomes to executive leadership and senior stakeholders.

Core Competencies

Technology strategy and enterprise architecture leadership.
Organizational leadership, coaching, talent development, and succession planning.
