new_jobs.title: Director, Reliability Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Lumotive is pioneering the era of programmable optics—where light is controlled as intelligently and flexibly as software.

At the heart of this transformation is a once-in-a-generation innovation: a flat CMOS-based “general purpose optic.” Lumotive’s Light Control Metasurface (LCM™) beam forming chips can be programmed to function as a beam steering mirror, a lens, mirror, a beam splitter—or any optical function—replacing bulky and mechanical optical components with a fully digital, reconfigurable semiconductor . This breakthrough lays the foundation for a massive shift in multiple technologies—from 3D sensing and imaging to optical networking, free space optical communication, and beyond. Like the shift from analog to digital in electronics, programmable optics will reshape industries from robotics, self-driving cars, AI, defense, and healthcare.

Lumotive’s first commercial application is in LiDAR, where its software-defined beam steering chips are already enabling compact, high-performance, solid-state sensors. These sensors are being deployed today in smart infrastructure, robotics, and mobility systems through leading module makers and solution integrators.

With more than 200 patents and growing commercial traction, Lumotive is delivering the world’s first digital platform for light—and redefining what’s possible in the optical age.

Job Description:

We are looking for a Director of Reliability Engineering to own reliability end to end — from the physics of how an LCM degrades to the qualification data package delivered for customer sign-off.

The LCM is a new class of semiconductor device: a CMOS backplane, novel thin-film material stacks, and liquid crystal. It ships into products whose mission profiles range from climate-controlled indoor robotics to outdoor infrastructure and automotive-grade exposure. The standard qualification playbooks were not written for this device, and the acceleration models often have to be built from data we generate ourselves.

You will set the reliability and qualification strategy for the LCM and the reference designs in which they are deployed, collect customer mission profiles and translate them into stress conditions and lifetime requirements, run the studies that determine whether we meet them, and drive the findings back into process, materials, design, and system architecture. You will also present our reliability data directly to customers and their quality teams.

We want someone who runs qualification surgically: studies that are carefully designed, well controlled, and executed as planned, so the result holds up when a customer challenges it. Someone with the depth to work unfamiliar failure modes from first principles, the judgment to know which risks matter at the system level, and the instinct to hunt for the failure modes we have not characterized yet — before a customer finds them.

Responsibilities:

Own the reliability pipeline end to end — from fundamental LCM failure-mechanism studies through component, module, and system qualification, to the data package delivered for customer sign-off. You are accountable for our lifetime claims and the evidence behind them
Own customer mission profiles. Work with sales, applications, and systems engineering to collect use conditions across a widening set of products — thermal and humidity profiles, duty cycles, optical exposure, power cycling, lifetime expectations — and convert them into qualification plans
Run qualification surgically. Design each study to isolate the mechanism in question — controls, sample structure, stress levels, readpoints — and hold execution to that plan
Unearth the failure modes we have not seen yet. Maintain a living map of known, suspected, and unexamined mechanisms across chip, package, and module, and design the experiments that close the gaps before a customer finds them
Build lifetime models — time-to-failure distributions, acceleration factors, activation energies, sample size and confidence bounds — and defend the assumptions under customer scrutiny
Close the loop into design and process. Drive Design for Reliability and Design for Test reviews so our products are stress-able and testable, and correlate reliability outcomes to fab process splits, materials, and assembly variables through split-lot DOEs with process and packaging partners
Define screening strategy — pass/fail criteria, burn-in, production screens, and ongoing reliability monitoring — to keep early failures out of customer deliveries
Represent reliability to customers. Present data, negotiate qualification scope, and answer customer quality teams directly
Work across teams. Reliability touches LCM process and device, ASIC, hardware, systems, manufacturing, and program management; make sure a finding in one team turns into a decision in the others
Build and lead the reliability team. Hire, mentor, and set the technical and documentation standard: every study written up with conclusions and next steps

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or related fields
Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or related fields is preferred
15+ years in semiconductor or optoelectronic reliability, failure analysis, or quality engineering, including leading a reliability function, team, or major qualification program
A proven track record taking a new technology from prototype through qualification into volume production — at least one program you can walk through end to end
Deep hands-on foundation: you have designed accelerated stress tests, done failure analysis, and built lifetime models, and can still work the data directly
Statistical fluency: time-to-failure distributions (Weibull, lognormal), acceleration modeling (Arrhenius, Peck), sample size and confidence planning, lifetime projection to use conditions
Rigor in experimental design and execution: controls, sample structure, stress levels, readpoints, and the discipline to hold a study to its plan
Experience with novel device technologies or material sets with undocumented failure modes — worked from first principles rather than an established qual flow
Experience translating customer mission profiles into qualification plans and lifetime requirements
Experience owning qualification at both component and module/system level
Working knowledge of JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q102, and ISO, and the judgment to adapt them to devices they were not written for
Experience presenting qualification data directly to external customers and their quality organizations
Outstanding written and verbal communication; disciplined about documenting work
Intellectual curiosity and ownership: you think about what can fail constantly, and you dig until you understand why
Background in liquid crystal devices (LCoS, displays), MEMS, image sensors, or photonics is preferred
Automotive or industrial qualification experience where your data was audited by a customer is preferred
Experience building a reliability function from a small team, defining process where none existed is preferred
Experience running split-lot DOEs with wafer fabs or materials vendors to improve intrinsic reliability is preferred
Experience defining burn-in and production screening for early-failure elimination is preferred
Experience with lidar, 3D sensing, or optical modules and their system-level tradeoffs is preferred

new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As an Amazon Web Services, Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Director, you will lead client engagements focused on cloud infrastructure and network architecture, shaping solutions that streamline integration, improve connectivity, and support technology performance. As a Director you will set strategic direction, drive business growth, and guide executive-level relationships while mentoring teams and promoting a culture where quality, integrity, inclusion, and commercial thinking guide decision-making. In this role at PwC, you will bring together cloud architecture, AWS deployment, IT operations, and network design to help clients modernize infrastructure, resolve complex technical challenges, and move technology programs forward within our Advisory practice.

In this role at PwC, you will be instrumental in driving business growth and shaping client engagements.You will foster environments where people and technology thrive together, promoting technological advances and creating a healthy working environment. Your leadership will be crucial in mentoring the next generation of leaders, upholding PwC's reputation for quality, integrity, and inclusion. You will identify gaps in the market and convert opportunities into success for the firm, all while adhering to professional and technical standards.

Responsibilities

Leading AWS cloud infrastructure and network architecture engagements from strategy through delivery
Shaping client technology roadmaps and defining target states for cloud and platform transformation
Developing AWS-based infrastructure designs across compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and security controls
Directing migration planning, platform modernization, and network integration activities across complex environments
Reviewing architecture frameworks, technical designs, and operating models to align with client goals
Guiding IT operations, service management, and troubleshooting activities for cloud and network platforms
Identifying opportunities to apply AWS services, cloud computing, and DevOps practices to improve delivery outcomes
Coaching teams on platform engineering, architecture decisions, and technical issue resolution
Building executive-level client relationships and advancing business development opportunities in the technology market
Driving collaboration across internal teams to shape scalable solutions for technology, media, and telecommunications clients

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience in cloud or infrastructure consulting with demonstrated AWS program leadership

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering
At least one of the following: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or Advanced AWS certifications

Achieving AWS competencies, specializations, or partner designations through prior alliance and capability-building efforts
Demonstrating industry expertise across cloud transformation and client delivery
Demonstrating AWS cloud infrastructure architecture design for client solutions
Leading cloud and network architecture initiatives across multiple engagements

new_jobs.title: VP, Technology & AI
new_jobs.description:
The VP, Technology & AI (T&AI)
is a newly created leadership position at Woodruff. We’re looking for a transparent, innovative and results-driven leader with a diverse background to lead our technology vision and delivery capabilities within our T&AI core strength.

This role is responsible for advancing how technology, with an emphasis on AI, enhances both client outcomes and agency operations. By combining deep technical expertise with a forward-looking perspective on emerging technologies, this role ensures the agency remains at the forefront of digital experience development, automation, integration, quality assurance and AI-driven innovation.

This leader plays a key role in evaluating and implementing AI initiatives that improve efficiency, expand service offerings and create competitive advantage. The ideal candidate will partner closely with other agency leadership and cross-functional teams to shape future capabilities, establish best practices and foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

The VP of technology & AI will be a member of Woodruff’s leadership team, working closely with them to drive forward-thinking strategies and impactful technology solutions in order to achieve our goals and build a strong business and culture of trust. This person will also be responsible for building, mentoring and developing high-performing technology teams, ensuring technology strengths continue to evolve and drive long-term agency success.

This person must be located in the Kansas City or Columbia, MO, area.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Technology & AI Leadership

Define and lead the agency's technology and AI vision and roadmap, ensuring investments align with client needs and future growth opportunities
Establish and champion the agency's AI strategy, identifying where and how AI can create value across internal operations, client work, workflows and service offerings
Lead a disciplined approach to AI adoption by focusing investments in high-impact opportunities with clear outcomes
Pilot and implement emerging technologies, AI platforms and other technical solutions that improve efficiency, enhance capabilities and create competitive advantage
Develop and oversee AI governance, policies and best practices to ensure responsible, effective and secure adoption across the organization
Define the agency's vision for search in the AI era by integrating SEO, AI optimization (AIO), structured data and generative search best practices into client strategies while mentoring teams on emerging technologies and evolving search behavior
Serve as the agency's technology and AI thought leader, staying ahead of emerging technologies, evolving AI legislation, regulatory requirements and industry best practices while educating teams, guiding responsible AI adoption and driving the implementation of innovative tools and approaches that deliver measurable business value
Oversee our internal technology needs and external IT services, collaborating with our operations team.

Technical Strategy & Executional Leadership

Advise internal teams and clients on technology and AI opportunities, helping shape strategies that improve business outcomes, customer experiences and operational effectiveness
Alongside our technical architect, provide deep technical expertise and practical guidance to ensure the successful execution of complex digital and technology initiatives
Alongside our technical architect, consult on the development, implementation, QA and maintenance of websites, digital platforms, applications, marketing technology solutions and integrated technology ecosystems
Roll up your sleeves to support critical initiatives, using hands-on execution as a vehicle for coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Cross-Function Collaboration

Partner with agency leadership and cross-functional teams to assess and evolve technology and AI capabilities that support agency growth
Foster interconnected ways of working across core strengths, ensuring technology and AI considerations are integrated throughout project life cycles
Establish and improve documentation standards, workflows and operational processes that strengthen collaboration across disciplines and create greater visibility into how systems, tools, teams and technologies work together
Support business development, scoping and estimation efforts by providing technical expertise and strategic guidance during planning and proposal development.

Team Development

Build, mentor and develop high-performing technology teams while cultivating a culture of innovation and continuous learning
Continuously assess the performance, structure and maturity of the Technology & AI core strength, making recommendations that strengthen capabilities, improve delivery and support long-term agency success.

Supervisor Expectations:

Expectation setting, including working with your direct report on new staff orientation, training and work assignment
Departmental responsibilities, including working with your direct report on policy enforcements, OOO requests and adhering to hiring criteria
Regular communication, including one-on-ones, conflict resolution, philosophy guidance and ongoing coaching and mentoring
Employee enrichment, including working with your direct report on goal setting, timely performance reviews and ongoing feedback.

Knowledge and Skills:

Demonstrated success leading technology and AI strategy within an agency, consulting firm or complex marketing organization
Deep understanding of web technologies, marketing technology ecosystems systems integration and digital platforms
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies that drive measurable business outcomes
Strong understanding of SEO, AI optimization (AIO), generative search and the evolving search landscape
Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical business solutions
Experience leading cross-functional teams and mentoring technical professionals
Working knowledge of AI governance, privacy, security and the evolving regulatory landscape
Working knowledge of current web technologies
Working knowledge of CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal and/or Hubspot
Working knowledge of email marketing or CRM platforms such as SalesForce and/or Campaign Monitor
An entrepreneurial, forward-thinking spirit
Happy to build relationships and trust, connect the dots, find a better way to solve existing problems
Ability to identify simpler ways to solve problems
Ability to embrace our core value of freedom — to be bold, to experiment, to challenge, to act and to celebrate — and a history of doing so throughout their career.

Leader Behaviors:

Open-minded and active listener
Continually grows people and business
Truthful and transparent
Decisive and accountable
Forward-thinking
Proactive and communicates in a positive manner

Education/Experience/Certification(s):

12+ years of relevant experience in a technology and AI field
Both agency and non-agency experience is applicable
Experience in leading a cross-functional team
Change management experience
Agile development experience

Woodruff’s Perks That Support Growth and Flexibility:

We offer a range of benefits designed to support your work-life balance and empower you to stay creative, curious and courageous:
Flexible work setup — choose hybrid work, or join us in our Kansas City or Columbia, MO, offices
"Freedom Fridays" — no meetings on Friday mornings/Friday afternoons to use as you see fit
Diverse, meaningful work — contribute to projects across a wide range of industries
Collaborative, growth-focused culture — work with a supportive team that helps you build new skills
And more — from wellness support to peer recognition, we value and invest in our people.

new_jobs.title: Equity Research, Vice President, Technology Management (Alpharetta)
new_jobs.description:
Research Technology Management – Vice President, AI Enablement Lead (Alpharetta)

Morgan Stanley Global Research is seeking a Vice President to serve as AI Enablement Lead within the Research Technology Management (RTM) organization. The AI Enablement Lead will be responsible for driving the practical adoption, development, governance, and optimization of generative AI and related AI capabilities across Global Research.

The role will lead the department’s dedicated AI Enablement team, currently comprising five Prompt Engineers and four Annotators, and will operate at the intersection of Research, technology, data, AI/modeling, product management, training, and governance.

The AI Enablement Lead will be responsible for translating the needs of Global Research analysts and teams into scalable, compliant, high-value AI solutions. The role will oversee the complete enablement lifecycle—from identifying and prioritizing use cases through requirements definition, solution development, evaluation, deployment, adoption, measurement, and ongoing support.

The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial services and investment research workflows with hands-on AI and technical capabilities, product and project management experience, and demonstrated leadership skills. The individual must be comfortable operating both strategically and tactically: establishing an AI enablement framework and roadmap for the department while also contributing directly to solution design, prompt development, testing, evaluation, and implementation.

Responsible for executing and shaping AI adoption strategy for Global Research, identifying and prioritizing high-value use cases and building a roadmap that improves analyst workflows, productivity, and research processes, defining the optimal balance of centrally developed tools vs custom solutions, team enablement and support of teams with ready-to-deploy AI assets.
Lead the AI Enablement team (5 Prompt Engineers, 4 Annotators), setting priorities, managing delivery, developing talent, and driving best practices across generative AI initiatives.
Translate Research needs into AI solutions, partnering with analysts, technology, data, and product teams to design, deploy, evaluate, and support scalable AI tools, prompts, and workflows.
Drive AI governance and compliance, ensuring all AI solutions meet legal, risk, model governance, information security, and regulatory requirements within a highly controlled environment.
Serve as the AI subject matter expert for Research, evaluating emerging AI technologies, optimizing platform/model usage, and advising stakeholders on the most effective applications of generative AI.
Lead training, change management, and measurement efforts, increasing AI adoption through education, best practices, KPI tracking, user feedback, and reporting on business impact to senior leadership.

Ideal Background

5-10+ years in financial services, investment research, fintech, or related fields.
Strong understanding of financial markets and research workflows.
Hands-on experience with generative AI, prompt engineering, and Python.
Proven team leadership, product/project management, and stakeholder management experience.
Ability to bridge business, technology, and governance functions while driving enterprise AI initiatives.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

The Opportunity

As a Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Senior Manager you will lead client-facing cloud infrastructure and operations work within our Advisory practice, focusing on Amazon Web Services solutions that support platform design, deployment, and ongoing operations. As a Senior Manager you will bring strategic judgment, guide complex workstreams, coach teams through ambiguity, and communicate clear direction to stakeholders while balancing delivery priorities and service expectations. In this role at PwC, you will help shape secure, scalable cloud and network architecture solutions, drawing on your AWS knowledge, infrastructure operations background, and ability to translate technical needs into practical actions for clients.

Your ability to craft and convey clear, impactful messages and apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems will be crucial. This position offers the opportunity to deepen your skills and evolve your professional growth, contributing to the overall success of our firm.

Leading cloud infrastructure and network architecture workstreams for AWS deployment initiatives across client environments
Designing scalable cloud platforms, virtualization layers, and network connectivity models that support secure application delivery
Assessing current-state infrastructure, identifying architecture gaps, and translating findings into migration and modernization plans
Advising clients on AWS landing zones, cloud strategy, and infrastructure patterns aligned to business and technical requirements
Directing implementation of cloud networking, firewall controls, access protocols, and security performance tuning activities
Applying architecture frameworks, enterprise integration concepts, and infrastructure design methods to solve cross-platform challenges
Guiding teams through delivery issues, validating technical outcomes, and incorporating client feedback into solution design
Coaching team members on cloud engineering methods, delivery planning, and operational discipline across multiple workstreams
Communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs to client stakeholders and internal leadership in clear terms

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure delivery, including 2 or more years leading AWS work at enterprise scale

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering
At least one of the following: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional preferred; AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or relevant AWS Specialty certification
Master's of Science or an MBA is preferred
Leveraging AWS partner programs and funding mechanisms, including MAP, Enterprise Discount Programs, and private pricing, to support client strategy and solution economics

The Opportunity

As an Amazon Web Services, Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Director, you will lead client engagements focused on cloud infrastructure and network architecture, shaping solutions that streamline integration, improve connectivity, and support technology performance. As a Director you will set strategic direction, drive business growth, and guide executive-level relationships while mentoring teams and promoting a culture where quality, integrity, inclusion, and commercial thinking guide decision-making. In this role at PwC, you will bring together cloud architecture, AWS deployment, IT operations, and network design to help clients modernize infrastructure, resolve complex technical challenges, and move technology programs forward within our Advisory practice.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

St. Jude Children's Research Hospital is seeking an experienced and strategic leader to manage and advance the institution's research storage ecosystem. As the Senior Manager of Research Storage & Data Infrastructure within Research Information Services (RIS), you will lead the team responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance data infrastructure that supports world-class biomedical research, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and high-performance computing.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for St. Jude's scientific computing storage environment, encompassing active research storage, archival and object storage, cloud-integrated platforms, secure research environments, data protection services, and disaster recovery capabilities. You will define technology strategy, guide platform evolution, oversee major investments, and ensure operational excellence across systems that store and protect some of the institution's most valuable research assets.

Working closely with Information Services teams, research programs, administrative leadership, and external collaborators, you will serve as a trusted advisor on storage architecture, research computing operations, service quality, capacity planning, and technology roadmaps. The position also plays a critical role in aligning infrastructure capabilities with evolving scientific and institutional priorities.

A key responsibility of this role is managing strategic vendor partnerships, including operational governance, architecture reviews, service delivery management, procurement support, technology evaluations, and performance accountability. As the primary institutional representative for research storage platforms, you will ensure effective coordination among St. Jude stakeholders, technology partners, and the broader research community.

The successful candidate will oversee infrastructure supporting AI training and inference, high-performance computing, genomics, imaging, scientific instrumentation, and other data-intensive research workloads while maintaining robust business continuity, backup, and disaster recovery capabilities for mission-critical research services.

What You Will Do:

Storage Strategy & Architecture:

Develop and manage the roadmap for St. Jude’s centralized research storage platforms, including high-performance file systems, object storage, archival storage, cloud-integrated storage, and secure research environments.
Lead architecture planning for future growth associated with AI, machine learning, scientific computing, research instrumentation, and emerging research technologies.
Evaluate new technologies and vendor solutions to improve performance, resilience, scalability, user experience, and cost efficiency.
Support institutional planning for significant increases in research data volume and complexity.

Operations & Service Delivery:

Ensure reliable operation of research storage services supporting HPC, AI, regulated research environments, institutional applications, and data-intensive science.
Establish and monitor service-level objectives, operational metrics, capacity forecasts, and performance benchmarks.
Develop reporting and dashboards to support leadership decision-making, budgeting, procurement, and lifecycle planning.
Lead incident management, root-cause analysis, change management, and continuous service improvement activities.
Document procedures and operational knowledge to support transparency and transfer across the institution and to new staff as well as updating and supporting centralized asset management and information security.

Vendor & Partner Management:

Serve as the primary relationship manager for storage vendors.
Lead governance meetings, technical reviews, architecture planning sessions, and service performance assessments.
Review equipment proposals, quotations, statements of work, and technology recommendations.
Define RACI models, escalation processes, and operational responsibilities across internal teams and service providers.

Research Data Management & Governance:

Partner with researchers, data stewards, and RIS leadership to align storage services with institutional data management objectives.
Support storage governance, archival processes, retention strategies, and lifecycle management activities.
Collaborate with Information Security and compliance partners to ensure appropriate controls for sensitive and regulated research data.
Promote data stewardship, efficient resource utilization, and sustainable storage growth.

Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity & Cyber Resilience:

Develop and maintain storage-related disaster recovery and business continuity strategies supporting institutional recovery objectives.
Ensure storage platforms are designed with resiliency, recoverability, backup, replication, immutable recovery, and cyber resilience capabilities.
Partner with Information Security, Technology Services, and RIS leadership to define recovery objectives, recovery procedures, and operational response plans.
Lead disaster recovery testing, recovery validation exercises, and documentation reviews.
Maintain architecture and operational documentation supporting audit readiness, business continuity, and disaster recovery requirements.
Identify and mitigate operational risks associated with storage infrastructure, vendor dependencies, capacity constraints, and emerging technologies.

Leadership & Team Development:

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of storage engineers, infrastructure specialists, and trusted consultants.
Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, innovation, collaboration, and customer service.
Support hiring, performance management, career development, succession planning, and workforce growth.
Build strong partnerships across RIS, Technology Services, Information Security, Shared Resources, and the research community.

Qualifications:

Required Education:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in business administration, computer science, data science, information science or related field.

Required Experience:

8+ years of progressive IT experience with experience managing small/mid-size teams, preferably enterprise-scale storage infrastructure, research computing environments, or large-scale data platforms.
Experience leading complex projects/delivery in terms of resources, vendors and budgets.
Experience managing teams in a supervisory/ leadership capacity, preferably 3+ years of experience leading technical teams or infrastructure operations.
Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role.

Highly Preferred Experience:

Experience managing storage technologies across on-premises, colocation, and/or cloud environments.
Experience working with storage vendors, managed service providers, or strategic technology partners.
Strong understanding of storage architecture, capacity planning, backup, replication, data protection, disaster recovery, business continuity, on-premises and cloud data storage, and performance optimization.

new_jobs.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Delivery Senior Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Cloud Infrastructure and Operations Senior Manager you will lead client-facing cloud infrastructure and operations work within our Advisory practice, focusing on Amazon Web Services solutions that support platform design, deployment, and ongoing operations. As a Senior Manager you will bring strategic judgment, guide complex workstreams, coach teams through ambiguity, and communicate clear direction to stakeholders while balancing delivery priorities and service expectations. In this role at PwC, you will help shape secure, scalable cloud and network architecture solutions, drawing on your AWS knowledge, infrastructure operations background, and ability to translate technical needs into practical actions for clients.

In this role, you will be working within the Cloud Engineering, Data & Analytics network. You will design and build scalable and secure technology platforms, enabling insight-driven decision-making. Your ability to craft and convey clear, impactful messages and apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems will be crucial. This position offers the opportunity to deepen your skills and evolve your professional growth, contributing to the overall success of our firm.

Responsibilities

Leading cloud infrastructure and network architecture workstreams for AWS deployment initiatives across client environments
Designing scalable cloud platforms, virtualization layers, and network connectivity models that support secure application delivery
Assessing current-state infrastructure, identifying architecture gaps, and translating findings into migration and modernization plans
Advising clients on AWS landing zones, cloud strategy, and infrastructure patterns aligned to business and technical requirements
Directing implementation of cloud networking, firewall controls, access protocols, and security performance tuning activities
Applying architecture frameworks, enterprise integration concepts, and infrastructure design methods to solve cross-platform challenges
Guiding teams through delivery issues, validating technical outcomes, and incorporating client feedback into solution design
Coaching team members on cloud engineering methods, delivery planning, and operational discipline across multiple workstreams
Communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs to client stakeholders and internal leadership in clear terms

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure delivery, including 2 or more years leading AWS work at enterprise scale

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering
At least one of the following: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional preferred; AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or relevant AWS Specialty certification
Master's of Science or an MBA is preferred
Leveraging AWS partner programs and funding mechanisms, including MAP, Enterprise Discount Programs, and private pricing, to support client strategy and solution economics
Applying deep industry knowledge to shape cloud transformation strategies and solutions
Demonstrating AWS cloud infrastructure architecture across complex client environments
Leading cloud operations and platform engineering initiatives
Crafting client-ready messages and coaching teams through ambiguity

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

new_jobs.title: Director of IT Infrastructure (NCS) - BCIT
new_jobs.description:
THIS IS A NON-CIVIL SERVICE POSITION

Salary Range:

$122,569.00 - $202,068.00 Annually

Get to Know Us

Welcome to the City of Baltimore! Experience the reward of a fulfilling career and enjoy the added element of excitement in a vibrant, diverse atmosphere. The City of Baltimore offers limitless opportunities to help drive social impact, both on the job and in the community, while serving its citizens. Join us in making Baltimore a great place to live and work. In the City of Baltimore, we hire great people and provide them with the skills and opportunities to grow toward their career aspirations. If you are looking for a career change or interested in learning more, explore our opportunities and benefits programs. We are excited to have you as a part of the City of Baltimore Team! The city offers medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, optional life, AD&D, and FSA plans. This office also supplies wellness programs, support groups, and workshops. You can learn about our benefits here: https://humanresources.baltimorecity.gov/hr-divisions/benefits

Job Summary

The Director, Infrastructure serves as the senior leader responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of Baltimore City’s enterprise technology environment, overseeing data centers, network and cloud infrastructure, Service Desk operations, desktop support, storage, and email services. This role drives the City’s hybrid cloud strategy, ensures 24/7 operational continuity, strengthens cybersecurity in partnership with the CISO, and leads modernization efforts that support agency operations citywide. The Director provides strategic planning, budget oversight, vendor and contract management, and cross‑functional leadership to ensure Baltimore’s technology foundation is resilient, cost‑effective, and aligned with long‑term IT priorities.

Essential Functions

Leadership & People Management

Lead all supervisory functions: recruiting, hiring, staffing plans, performance management, training, conflict resolution, and corrective actions.
Represent BCIT to senior leadership, delivering regular updates on infrastructure performance, key projects, and issue resolution.
Build a culture of collaboration and shared accountability—no finger-pointing, just problem-solving.

Infrastructure Operations

Ensure 24/7 reliability through system monitoring, backups, performance tuning, patching, and OS upgrades across all platforms.
Manage internet and network infrastructure, including firewall administration and around-the-clock connectivity support.
Direct Service Desk and desktop support to achieve high first-call resolution rates and effective ticket escalation.
Administer on-call schedules and participate in rotation as needed.

Security & Resilience

Partner with the CISO and security teams to align infrastructure operations with the City’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring network, endpoint, and data center environments meet current standards and compliance requirements.
Drive improvement of securing the infrastructure—including network segmentation, least-privilege access controls, and multi-factor authentication—to reduce the City’s attack surface and limit the impact of any security incident.
Lead infrastructure-level preparedness for cyber threats, including ransomware response planning, regular tabletop exercises, and ensuring backup and recovery systems are isolated, tested, and ready to execute.

Strategy & Planning

Develop infrastructure roadmaps and strategies aligned with agency needs and the City’s long-term technology vision.
Own the City’s hybrid cloud infrastructure strategy—defining standards for workload placement, managing cloud provider relationships, and ensuring on-premise and cloud environments are integrated, secure, and cost-effective.
Drive cloud cost optimization across the infrastructure portfolio, establishing governance around cloud spend, rightsizing resources, and identifying opportunities to consolidate or migrate workloads to reduce total cost of ownership.
Contribute to annual operating and capital budget planning; manage assigned budget with full accountability.
Participate in enterprise-wide strategic planning and multi-agency IT initiatives.
Monitor emerging technology trends and integrate best practices to continuously advance BCIT’s capabilities.

Procurement & Contract Management

Cultivate vendor relationships to maximize value from partner products and services.
Review citywide technology purchase requests to ensure compliance with BCIT standards and IT strategy.
Manage hardware and software procurement within budget, with proper justification and approval documentation.
Oversee infrastructure contracts: enforce terms, prevent unintended auto-renewals, and approve monthly invoices for leases, maintenance, and services.

Architecture & Service Delivery

Develop and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs) that set clear performance expectations for end users.
Partner with development teams and user groups to design effective IT architecture and drive timely issue resolution.
Maintain accurate, up-to-date asset inventory for all BCIT technology assets.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Have a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline preferred.

Relevant certifications are a plus: Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), AWS Solutions Architect, or Microsoft Azure Administrator.

Prior IT experience in a government environment is strongly preferred.

OR

Equivalency Notes:
Have an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. If a degree is unrelated to IT, specialized IT experience is required. Advanced technical certifications may substitute for up to six months of experience or education, and multiple certifications may receive additional credit.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

10+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure management, with a background in Enterprise Architecture, Systems or Network Architecture and Administration, or Data Center Operations and Management.
Deep expertise in enterprise architecture with the ability to evaluate and integrate complex solutions across functional areas.
Strong knowledge of ITIL frameworks, Change Management methodologies, and cybersecurity principles.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, drive complex projects, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Experience developing and executing Disaster Recovery plans, including tabletop exercises.
Demonstrated track record leading hybrid cloud infrastructure strategy and implementation (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) at enterprise scale, including cloud cost governance, FinOps practices, and workload optimization.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills—able to communicate effectively at all levels of an organization.
Ability to perform technology gap analysis, identify opportunities, and propose enterprise-level solutions.
Working knowledge of AI technologies, frameworks, and ethical considerations, with the ability to identify opportunities for innovation.
Deep understanding of modern cybersecurity frameworks and practices—including zero trust architecture, network segmentation, endpoint security, and least-privilege access controls—with demonstrated experience partnering with CISO or security functions to drive infrastructure-level security strategy.
Experience managing infrastructure vendor relationships and contracts, including procurement governance, SLA enforcement, renewal pipeline management, and invoice oversight for leases and maintenance agreements.

Additional Information

Background Check

Eligible candidates under final consideration for appointment to positions identified as positions of trust will be required to complete authorization for a Criminal Background Check and/or Fingerprint must be successfully completed.

Probation

All persons, including current City employees, selected for this position must complete a mandatory six-month/1-year probation.

Financial Disclosure

This position is required to complete a Financial Disclosure pursuant to Sections 7-7, 7-8, and 7-9 of the City Ethics Law. T he initial financial disclosure must be submitted within 30 days of hire.

Baltimore City Government is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, and we are committed to a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. The City of Baltimore prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, ancestry, creed, national origin, disability status, genetics, marital status, military service, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Applicants requiring accommodations during the hiring process should contact the Department of Human Resources directly. Do not attach your request for accommodation to the application.

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Basketball Coverage
new_jobs.description:
About GameChanger

We believe in the life changing impact youth sports have on and off the field. Sports encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence – important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.

So if you love sports and their community building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

The Position

Our Basketball engineering organization is building and scaling the products that will help GameChanger grow in the most-played youth sport in the country. Within that org, the Coverage team owns the core experience of getting every game onto the platform: scorekeeping, live video capture, and the coaching tools built on top of that data.

As a Senior Engineering Manager on this team, you will lead a cross-functional group of engineers working across iOS, Android, and backend platforms, partnering closely with Product and Design to make covering a game as fast, reliable, and low-friction as possible. You will report to the Director of Engineering for Basketball.

What You'll Do

Coach and develop your engineers, setting clear expectations, identifying growth-oriented opportunities, and establishing a consistent cadence of feedback that fosters both development and accountability.
Define clear delivery goals for your team, partnering with cross-functional partners to shape priorities, navigate trade-offs and surface risks before they become problems.
Set and hold a consistent bar for engineering craft and system reliability, especially around live, in-game workflows where failures are highly visible to users on the sideline.
Hire and onboard strong engineers, keeping the bar high on values alignment, skill fit, and AI fluency.
Contribute to engineering culture and organizational effectiveness beyond your team through cross-team initiatives and helping shape how the broader org operates.

Who You Are

4+ years leading engineering teams and 6+ years of software development experience, with a track record of managing and growing engineering talent at all levels.
You have technical depth in one or more areas of our stack, with enough breadth to engage credibly in architecture conversations, hold a consistent standard for quality and reliability, and maintain the trust of senior engineers.
You have good product instincts, build strong working relationships with Product and Design partners, and know how to align on priorities in a way that drives meaningful outcomes.
You are active in developing your own AI fluency and in helping your team do the same. You hold a high bar for judgment and ownership regardless of how code gets written.

Perks

Work remotely throughout the US* or from our well-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY.
Unlimited vacation policy.
Paid volunteer opportunities.
Technology stipend - $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology.
WFH stipend - $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable.
Monthly physical, mental, wellness & learning stipend offered through Holisticly.
Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe.
Full health benefits - medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents.
Retirement savings - Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match.
Life insurance - basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life.
Disability leave - short-term disability and long-term disability.
Company paid parental leave - up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents.
Family building benefits offered through Progyny.
DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount.

The target salary range for this position is between $210,000 and $235,000. This is part of a total compensation package that includes incentive, equity, and benefits for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by several factors including experience, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We constantly review all teammate pay to ensure a great compensation package that is fair and equal across the board.

DICK'S Sporting Goods has company-wide practices to monitor and protect the company from significant compliance and monetary implications as it pertains to employer state tax liabilities. Due to said guidelines put in place, we are unable to hire in AK, DE, HI, IA, LA, MS, MT, OK, and SC.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

new_jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Director, Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, modernization, and ongoing support of enterprise technology solutions that enable the firm’s legal and business operations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for software engineering, application development, and systems integration, and engineering delivery functions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable and aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities.

The Director, Engineering partners closely with value stream leadership, IT services leaders, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality technology capabilities that improve attorney and business professional productivity, enhance client experience, and support revenue growth and operational efficiency.

This role is accountable for engineering execution discipline, technical quality, delivery reliability, and the evolution of reusable engineering and platform capabilities that accelerate the firm's transition to a build-capable technology organization.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic leadership for engineering and application development teams supporting firmwide legal and business capabilities across value streams.
Set technical direction, architectural standards, and engineering practices to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and operationally sustainable.
Partner closely with IT, legal operations, and business stakeholders to translate business outcomes and value stream priorities into executable technology roadmaps and engineering delivery strategy, keeping a user experience and product value mindset at the forefront.
Lead engineering execution and continuous delivery of technology capabilities, balancing innovation, platform stability, technical debt reduction, risk management, and operational excellence.
Collaborate across IT functions to improve delivery flow, reduce bottlenecks, and increase engineering throughput and reliability.
Oversee engineering efforts across multiple product and platform workstreams, balancing innovation, operational stability, quality, risk, and delivery commitments.
Establish and promote engineering best practices including automation, CI/CD, observability, resiliency, testing, reusable engineering capabilities, and operational readiness.
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, consultant resources, and third-party development partners as applicable to the success of the service portfolio and deliverables.
Lead, develop, and retain engineering management and senior technical talent, including performance management and succession planning.
Establish governance, metrics, and reporting for engineering performance, platform health, technical debt, operational sustainability, and delivery outcomes.
Ensure compliance with firm security, risk, governance, privacy, and data protection standards across all engineering activities.
Partner with infrastructure, operations, SRE, and end-user support teams to ensure stable production operations and smooth lifecycle support for delivered capabilities.
Provides leadership to and manages a team of business professionals to include coaching, mentoring and professional development. Responsible for providing performance feedback on a regular basis.

Desired Skills

Enterprise application architecture and modern development practices. Strategic planning and execution in complex environments. People leadership and organizational development. Financial and vendor management. Stakeholder partnership and executive communication. Risk management, security awareness, and operational excellence.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree in Technology, business, or management‑related discipline.

Certifications

Minimum Years Of Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering or application development, including at least five years in a senior leadership or management role overseeing multiple teams or portfolios.

At Shipwell, we are transforming logistics by turning supply chains into intelligent systems of action. We empower shippers to achieve unprecedented efficiency and service effectiveness at scale by putting artificial intelligence and automation to work. The Shipwell platform democratizes technology that was previously out of reach for many, combining transportation management (TMS), real-time multimodal visibility, procurement, and advanced machine learning into one comprehensive, intuitive solution. By leveraging autonomous digital agents—such as our Track & Trace AI Worker and natural-language AI Assistants—Shipwell automates the manual tasks that slow operations down. Built to adapt and scale alongside changing business demands, our platform enables shippers to proactively resolve freight exceptions, optimize costs, and manage the entire shipping process seamlessly.
As Shipwell celebrates a decade of innovation, industry experts continue to recognize our market traction and distinguish us as a leading force in modern logistics technology. Highlighting this evolution, Shipwell was recently named a "Visionary" in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Transportation Management Systems (advancing from previous recognitions in 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024). In 2026, the platform also won "Transport Management Platform of the Year" from SupplyTech Breakthrough and was named to the Inbound Logistics Top 100 Logistics & Supply Chain Technology List. These latest honors join a rich history of awards, including being named the fourth fastest-growing company in North America on the 2021, 2022, and 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500, winning FreightWaves’ 2021 and 2022 FreightTech Awards for Innovation and Disruption, earning Food Logistics’ 2022 Top Software & Technology Provider, and being recognized as a 2020 Forbes Next Billion-Dollar Startup.

Our Culture

Shipwell is a fast-paced, high-energy start-up that strives to build the future of shipping every day. Diversity of thought and cross-department collaboration is very important to us. We deliver open, honest, careful communication and work as hard as we play. We create & deliver solutions that are revolutionizing the industry, which brings excitement and purpose to our work. If you are looking for a place that will help you tap into your best work-self and give you hands-on experience building something big, then we invite you to come and build the future of shipping with us!
About you

The VP of Engineering will manage and continue to grow a world‐class software engineering team and drive the successful delivery of platforms and products while contributing to the product strategy, platform, and roadmap.
This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is energetic and has a passion for building leading-edge software. You love growing highly productive, remote, technical teams, and are driven to build a successful SaaS product used by thousands of happy businesses. You’re excited to lead an AI transformation and have experience building mission critical infrastructure. We foster an environment that empowers small teams to collaboratively set the technical direction of our solutions.

What you will do when you get here

Engineering Organizational Leadership
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing software engineering organization accountable for product delivery, technology evolution, security, reliability, and operational outcomes
Improve delivery predictability, developer productivity, software quality, resiliency, scalability, and cost effectiveness while balancing innovation, modernization, and commitments
Partner closely with executive leadership, product management, operations, and security to translate business strategy into executable technology priorities and investment decisions
Establish metrics and KPIs to measure strategic progress, software engineering effectiveness, AI adoption, and business impact
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to create competitive advantage through innovation
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology and AI-related opportunities, risks, and industry trends
Recruit world‐class engineering talent and participate in the recruiting flow including attracting, screening, and closing high caliber candidates.

AI Strategy, Mission Critical Infrastructure, & Innovation
Execute the organization's AI-first transformation strategy across products, software engineering, and AI with a prioritized roadmap tied to measurable business and customer outcomes
Execute and continue to evolve the R&D department’s AI strategy incorporating industry best practices and new technology innovation to continue to increase engineering and process efficiencies through AI technology
Drive incorporation of AI-powered experiences into customer-facing products and enterprise workflows
Oversee planning, execution, governance, risks, dependencies, and resource allocation for strategic technology and AI initiatives across the product portfolio
Stay current on industry advancements across models, agent orchestration, best practices and other emerging technology innovations
Promote a SMART codebase (Simple, Maintainable, Agile, Refactored and Tested) for a SAFE product (Secure, Available, Fast and Easy).
Manage the delivery of software using Agile best practices including continuous deployment, continuous integration, and test-driven development.
Ensure the team fully understands the goals and objectives of Shipwell as a company and how their work fits into the bigger picture.

What you need to have

BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related technical discipline
Proven experience leading engineering teams during the evolution of the Engineering function from start-‐up to the mid lifecycle.
Demonstrated track record of successfully hiring, managing, coaching and retaining world-class engineers.
Software development experience building mission critical enterprise SaaS, cloud-based solutions, or consumer web platforms supporting millions of users and billions of online transactions per month.
Demonstrated experience leading the design, development, delivery, and maintenance of large scale and high-performance platforms, including online web and data/analytics processing.
Recent experience using Agile methodologies.
Knowledge of release management and deployment workflow processes, from development release through staging and production deployment.
Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build productive cross-departmental relationships and motivate team members. Must have a positive, can-do attitude and value collaboration.

What we offer

Incredible growth opportunity at one of the fastest-growing companies in Austin
Competitive Pay
401k
Amazing company culture
Room to grow and tons of mentoring
Gym reimbursement 
Being a part of a startup company
Company-sponsored healthcare insurance and dental insurance
Receive an elite technology package to include a brand new MacBook Pro!
Remote work environment where everyone (even the new folks) has a voice

The Salary Range for this role is between $175,000 - $200,000 USD including Variable Compensation based on Years of Experience, Skillset, and Location.
Here at Shipwell, we are a Remote Forward company. We are located in Austin, TX but this position will  be fully remote. 
Shipwell is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any sort. We do celebrate diversity and believe experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Diversity in our team makes for better problem solving, more creative thinking, and ultimately a better product and company culture.
Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of impact, dedication, and the ability to thrive in a fast paced and collaborative environment. Shipwell strives to have an inclusive work environment; so if you are hard working & good at what you do then please come as you are.  We want you to contribute, grow, & learn at Shipwell and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for.
We are looking forward to adding new perspectives to our team!

new_jobs.title: Director, AWS Infrastructure and DevOps
new_jobs.description:
About Inizio Evoke

In the journey of life, your career should make a difference.

At Inizio Evoke, we come together—to do the best work, in the best possible place. We're all in. Because it's everyone's role to make health more human™

About The Role

The Director, AWS Infrastructure and DevOps is responsible for the strategy, architecture, security, and operational execution of our technology infrastructure and DevOps capabilities. This role will own and execute the day-to-day management of AWS cloud infrastructure. Additionally, it will oversee continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines, release and deployment processes, SaaS administration and provisioning, security and compliance, and infrastructure cost optimization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technology professional who can establish scalable operational practices while partnering closely with Engineering, Security, and IT teams to ensure the reliable, secure, and efficient delivery of technology services.

Here's what you'll be doing:

Lead the strategy, architecture, implementation, administration, and day-to-day operation of our AWS infrastructure and cloud services.
Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure and environments.
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, logging, alerting, backup, and disaster recovery capabilities.
Define and implement cloud architecture standards across networking, compute, storage, databases, identity, and access management.
Facilitate infrastructure modernization, automation, and optimization programs to improve reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.
Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting application development, testing, security scanning, and production deployment.
Define and implement DevOps standards, tooling, processes, and engineering practices across development teams.
Own and execute release and deployment processes across development, staging, and production environments, including deployment automation, release coordination, validation, and rollback procedures.
Own the administration, governance, and lifecycle management of our SaaS technology ecosystem.
Implement and manage SaaS tool provisioning, user onboarding/offboarding, role and permission management, access reviews, and license management.
Manage cloud infrastructure cost management and optimization, including monitoring, forecasting, resource utilization, and identification and execution of cost-saving opportunities.
Partner with Security and Compliance teams to define and implement infrastructure and DevOps security controls and practices.
Implement and maintain appropriate controls for identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, vulnerability management, logging, and infrastructure security.
Support security audits, compliance assessments, customer security reviews, and regulatory requirements, including implementation and maintenance of required controls and evidence.
Monitor infrastructure and application environments, troubleshoot production and deployment issues, and lead root-cause analysis and remediation efforts.
Evaluate infrastructure, DevOps tooling, and operational practices and identify opportunities to improve reliability, security, developer experience, and efficiency.

About You

Qualifications:

8+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, cloud engineering, DevOps, or related technology disciplines, with demonstrated ownership of production environments.
Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating AWS cloud infrastructure and services.
Scripting and automation experience using Python or TypeScript
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience designing and managing modern CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows.
Experience with release and deployment management, including deployment automation, production releases, rollback procedures, and troubleshooting.
Experience with cloud security, IAM, networking, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit controls.
Experience with SaaS administration, user provisioning, access management, and lifecycle management.
Experience with cloud infrastructure cost management and optimization.
And the ability to design, implement, operate, and troubleshoot production systems.
Support off business hours deployments and releases if needed
AWS certification such as AWS Solutions Architect or AWS DevOps Engineer is preferred.

Work Environment & Benefits

Inizio Evoke offers a fully remote work environment and outstanding company-paid benefits, including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities and encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply—you may be the right fit for this or another role within our team.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation

$135,000—$150,000 USD

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.
